jobs.title: Carrot: Director, Information Security
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote

About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

The Opportunity 

Carrot is looking for a Director, Information Security to lead the security program that protects the highly sensitive fertility and family-building data of members around the world. You will set the security strategy, own both corporate security (GRC, incident response, security awareness, vendor risk) and product security (application, cloud and infrastructure security, secure development lifecycle), and serve as the trusted voice on Carrot's security posture with executives, auditors, and enterprise customers.

Day to day, you will balance setting direction with staying close to the work: prioritizing risk with Engineering and IT, guiding audit and certification cycles, coaching a small and talented team, and joining customer conversations where security is part of the buying decision. Carrot has already earned SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, HITRUST, and PCI DSS compliance, so this role is about taking a strong foundation to the next level of maturity, not starting from scratch.

What makes this role different is the combination of stakes and influence. Few security leaders get to protect data this personal, at global scale, while working directly with executive leadership and shaping how a health platform is built, sold, and trusted.

What You’ll Own

In this role, you will:

  • Lead Carrot's security strategy and roadmap, using a recognized maturity model (such as C2M2 or NIST CSF) to prioritize investments and report progress to executive leadership
  • Own the full security program across corporate security (GRC, incident management, security awareness, third-party risk) and product security (application security, cloud and infrastructure security, secure SDLC)
  • Partner with Engineering, especially the Internal Platform team, to build security into how Carrot designs, ships, and operates its systems, going beyond compliance
  • Lead internal risk assessments across application, cloud, and corporate environments and turn the results into prioritized technical safeguards
  • Own the compliance portfolio, including SOC 2 Type II, HITRUST, PCI DSS, and HIPAA, and prepare Carrot for additional frameworks such as ISO 27001 as the business requires
  • Direct incident response readiness, including playbooks, tabletop exercises, executive communication, and post-incident learning
  • Represent Carrot's security posture to employers, health plans, and health systems through security reviews, questionnaires, and strategic sales conversations
  • Work with Legal and Privacy to meet global data protection requirements (HIPAA, GDPR, CCPA/CPRA) for member health data
  • Build, coach, and grow the security team, balancing hands-on execution with delegation as the team scales
  • Manage the security budget, tooling, and vendor relationships, and tailor security guidance for a remote-first workforce and physical offices

What Success Looks Like  

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

  • A documented, executive-endorsed security strategy and multi-year roadmap with clear priorities, owners, and measures of progress
  • Clean outcomes on recurring audits and certifications (SOC 2 Type II, HITRUST, PCI DSS), with remediation items closed on schedule
  • A tested incident response program, with regular tabletop exercises completed and lessons learned built back into the program
  • A measurable reduction in high-risk vulnerabilities and open security findings, with remediation timelines agreed on with Engineering
  • A living risk register and vendor security review process that leaders rely on to make decisions
  • A security team with defined roles, clear growth paths, and the right capacity for Carrot's growth, including key hires made
  • Faster, more consistent security reviews for Sales and Customer Success, with fewer escalations from enterprise customers
  • A clear plan, and visible progress, on any additional frameworks the business prioritizes, such as ISO 27001

About You

You likely have:

  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 10+ years of experience in technology, including 5+ years in information security and at least 3 years leading security teams
  • A security certification such as CISSP or CISM
  • Experience leading the security function at a late-stage startup, scale-up, or public company
  • Working depth in healthcare data protection and privacy frameworks, including HIPAA, GDPR, and CCPA/CPRA
  • Experience overseeing enterprise frameworks and audits such as SOC 2 Type II, HITRUST, PCI DSS, and ISO 27001
  • Strong knowledge of application, network, and cloud security (AWS and Azure) and frameworks such as NIST CSF and OWASP
  • Experience running core security programs, including incident response, risk management, vulnerability management, penetration testing, and security awareness
  • Executive-level communication skills and confidence engaging customers and sales teams on security requirements
  • Experience managing budget and allocating resources across people, tools, and vendors

 

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Experience leading security through a major company event such as an IPO, acquisition, or large-scale audit cycle
  • A background in healthcare, digital health, or another highly regulated, high-trust environment
  • Experience leading security in a remote-first, globally distributed company
  • Familiarity with compliance automation platforms such as Drata
  • Experience building a security engineering practice alongside platform and infrastructure teams

 

Why This Role Matters

Members trust Carrot with some of the most personal information a person can share, often during some of the most meaningful moments of their lives. Protecting that trust is not a back-office function. It is what allows employers, health plans, and health systems to bring Carrot to millions of people worldwide.

As Carrot grows, security leadership shapes how we build, how we sell, and how we show up for customers. In this role, you will make security a strength that members and customers can see and rely on, and build a team that keeps raising the bar as the business scales.

Why Candidates Join Carrot

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.
  • Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

 

Compensation: 

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their lives inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $188,000.00 - $245,000.00. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience. 

 

Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com

 

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Why Carrot?

Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com. 

 

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/carrot-director-information-security

jobs.title: Collibra: Senior Customer Engineer - Collibra Public Sector
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote, USA

Joining Collibra’s Public Sector team

The Federal Customer Engineer (CE) serves as the guiding force behind bringing Collibra Public Sector's (CPS) product and vision to customers and prospects. Senior Customer Engineers  are responsible for both net-new and expansion opportunities in existing accounts. They establish knowledgeable and trusted relationships from day one and serve as thoughtful technical advisors. The CE maintains a technical relationship with customers throughout the entire customer journey, both pre- and post-sale. You will fill an essential and highly respected role in the sales organization at CPS.

As a Federal Customer Engineer at Collibra Public Sector, you will support our nation’s most critical agencies in achieving Data Sovereignty and Mission Intelligence. You will partner with Federal Account Executives to navigate the unique procurement and technical landscapes of the DoW, Civilian and the Intelligence Community agencies. Your goal is to show how Collibra’s Self-Hosted and FedRAMP-authorized platforms can break down agency silos, ensure regulatory compliance, and accelerate the secure adoption of AI.

Senior Customer Engineers at Collibra are responsible for

Presales

  • Lead in-depth technical discovery sessions to uncover complex needs and environments and recommend solutions
  • Owns delivery of technical evaluation efforts with input from specialists for (Data Quality, Privacy, AI Governance and the core Collibra Platform).
  • Works closely with the Account Executive to craft win-win sales proposals and influence decisions.
  • Participates in discovery and drives qualification of new opportunities, and expands Collibra solutions with existing customers.
  • Prepares and owns functional and technical sections of RFPs/RFQs.

Demonstration/Presentation delivery

  • Deliver focussed demonstration, creating sample/custom assets and configure workflows as required to meet client needs.
  • Deliver focused presentations and roadmaps to key stakeholders across both business and technology
  • Deliver complex tailored demonstrations and discuss in detail customization capabilities for specific use cases.
  • Present tailored product roadmap presentation based on customer's priorities and current/future use cases
  • Deliver complex multi-disciplinary workshops from start to finish involving internal and external stakeholders.
  • Lead and own workshops, be the key driver for the agenda, and ensure outcomes result in positive outcomes for client and Collibra.
  • Lead product and technical sections of regular business reviews with key customers
  • Prepare and conduct product demonstrations, highlighting how Collibra’s Platform can support our Federal Government customer requirements.
  • Identifying, evaluating, recommending, and executing value-based workshops and proof of concepts/values. 
  • Deliver tailored demonstrations that address specific Federal mandates (e.g., OMB M-24-10 regarding AI Governance, CDO Council priorities, and Executive Orders on Data Sharing).
  • Lead technical Proof of Value (PoV) engagements within agency environments.
  • Ensure successful deployment of Collibra Edge behind agency firewalls.

Relationship Management

  • Acts as the technical authority on Collibra’s security posture, including FedRAMP (Moderate), IL4/IL5 requirements, and SOC2 compliance.
  • Acts as a liaison between the client and internal teams on complex requirements and issues that need clarification.
  • Leads complex evaluation efforts, coordinating cross-functional resources, and complex testing scenarios.
  • Document customer use cases and value realized (or to be realized for new) leveraging value consulting team where relevant.
  • Proactively engages with senior-level and strategically important customer/prospect representatives, influencing product-related decisions.
  • Develops executive-level credibility and trust, influencing customer-focused solution development and purchasing decisions.
  • Build independent relationships to identify growth opportunities.
  • Act as a go-to subject matter expert for specific product areas, industries, or complex technical domains.

Adoption and Expansion

  • Architect highly customized and integrated solutions for identified Agency use cases
  • Collaborate with Solution Architects in providing guidance on solution design for new use cases.
  • Support customer identification of value and ROI. Support customer use case library aligned to data strategy and business value, leveraging the services team when and where required.
  • Actively support account growth strategies with the AE/AM.
  • Understand in detail the specific differentiators for Collibra solutions, including strengths and weaknesses of competition.
  • Provide thought leadership on best practices for adoption and technical optimizations. 
  • Influences product and service direction to enhance overall client experience.
  • Design and validate future-state technical architectures for major transformation projects, integrating across vast complex ecosystems
  • Mapping solutions to value across large and dynamic customers, bridging both business and technical requirements.
  • Advising and supporting customers’ technical stakeholders to accelerate Collibra adoption and value realization, i.e., be the primary point of contact for technical and product-related queries. 
  • Architect solutions that function across complex Federal environments, including on-premises, hybrid cloud, and disconnected/classified networks.
  • Help agencies build a "Unified Data Language" to facilitate secure data sharing between departments while maintaining strict access controls and data labeling.

Customer Support

  • Address technical questions, mitigate risks, and overcome objections related to security, scalability, integration and implementation.
  • Identify adoption roadblocks and ensure successful product usage. 
  • Drive technical resolution and best practices for common challenges. 
  • Document customer use cases and adoption challenges, providing guidance on adoption/value realization best practices.

Teaming

  • Provides onboarding assistance for CEs and allied sales team members.
  • Contributes to Customer Engineering participation in major projects and provides forward-looking technical guidance.
  • Maintain expert-level product knowledge across the portfolio.
  • Works internally to improve product marketing messaging and educate Sales/CEs.
  • Provides team members with technical and process guidance and advice.
  • Build and execute account specific competitive strategies, and contribute to the broader Collibra competitive landscape analysis. Understand the broader technology ecosystem and future trends.
  • Packages best practices and lessons learned into thought leadership, methodologies, and published assets to improve Customer Engineering processes.
  • Owns Customer Engineering participation in major projects and provides forward-looking technical guidance.
  • Supporting sales and marketing activities, webcasts, field enablement, and asset creation.
  • Providing advice and feedback to product management and engineering to enhance Collibra solutions and offerings.

You have

  • 5+ years in Sales Engineering or Technical Consulting, specifically supporting U.S. Federal Government customers with 4+ years working in the Data/SaaS space.
  • Proficiency in SQL and deep familiarity with Federal data stacks (e.g., Snowflake Government Data Cloud, AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, and Palantir) are a plus.
  • Working knowledge of NIST 800-53, FISMA, and the Federal Data Strategy.
  • Proven ability to navigate the Federal procurement cycle and build long-term relationships with Agency CDOs, CTOs, and Program Managers.
  • Experience should include a broad range of disciplines, including value-based selling, cost-benefit analysis, ROI analysis, process and project management.
  • Experience in regulatory compliance and or (financial/IT) audit is a plus. 
  • Experience working with leading PaaS providers, data lakes, databases, and integration platforms is required.
  • Familiarity in enterprise security solutions such as LDAP or Kerberos.
  • Experience working with Data Quality, Data Pipelines, Data Orchestration, and/or Job Control tools.
  • Knowledgeable of at least least two or three of the following: data management processes, including data governance, data stewardship, master data management, data cataloging, and business rules management
  • Experienced with Collibra or comparable technologies
  • Demonstrated proficiency in leveraging AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, Copilot) to solve real-world business challenges, drive measurable outcomes, or streamline workflows.
  • A bachelor’s degree or equivalent related working experience is required.

  • Because this role supports the U.S. government business, it is required that you are a U.S. citizen who resides on U.S. soil.

You are

  • Exceptional in communication, presentation and interpersonal skills including the ability to communicate effectively and build relationships within government entities.
  • Fast learner with an aptitude for grasping complex technical concepts.
  • Excellent organization and stakeholder management skills.
  • A proven collaborator and liaison with all levels and departments within an organization, with experience and success in both partner and contractor-heavy environments.
  • Confident in dispensing knowledge to a highly skilled and experienced audience.
  • Able to demonstrate a thorough understanding of business needs and revenue potential for accounts in the region.

Measures of success

  • Within your first month, you will become familiar with Collibra Public Sector and understand our customer landscape.
  • Within your second month, you should confidently conduct discovery with customers and prospects, initial product demonstrations, and be able to present solutions aligned to customer value.
  • Within your third month, you will become a voice for Collibra within your accounts and for your accounts back within Collibra - educating external and internal stakeholders on features, roadmap, and new use cases. Additionally you will drive operational excellence by ensuring the sales process runs smoothly and efficiently.

Compensation for this role

The standard base salary range for this position is $140,000 - $175,000 per year. This position is eligible for additional commission-based compensation. Salary offers are based on a combination of factors, including, but not limited to, experience, skills, and location.

In addition to base salary, we offer a competitive total rewards package, including bonus potential, equity for eligible roles, a Flex Fund monthly stipend, pension/401k plans, and more.

What Success Looks Like  

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

  • Delivered accurate, well-documented dashboards and reports that stakeholders across the company trust and use regularly

About You 

You likely have:

  • Ability to translate business intelligence needs from a variety of stakeholders into technical execution and clear presentation

Nice to Have ⭐

  • Experience using dbt to transform, test, and document data

  • Understanding of effective data modeling strategies and implementations

 

Why This Role Matters

Data is central to how Carrot operates and grows. Leaders across the company depend on accurate, timely reporting to serve members, support customers, and make sound business decisions. As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you will be the connective tissue between raw data and those decisions, ensuring the organization runs on insights it can trust.

Your work directly supports Carrot's mission of expanding access to fertility and family-building care worldwide. Better data means better decisions for the members and customers who rely on Carrot every day.

 

Interview Process 

We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team.

For this role, candidates can expect:

  1. Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes

  3. Cross-Functional Panel Interviews — 45 minutes
  4. Performance Task — 60 minutes

Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role.

 

Why Candidates Join Carrot

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.
  • Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

 

Compensation

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $98,000.00- $125,000.00. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Why Carrot?

Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.

jobs.title: Netlify: Senior Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote

About the Team

Netlify is a product-led growth company, and Revenue Operations owns the systems, data, and infrastructure that turn that growth into revenue.  With a large volume of people discovering and signing up for Netlify every day, Marketing Operations is critical to understanding those users, connecting activity across our systems, and creating scalable ways to engage them throughout their journey.

As Senior Marketing Operations Manager, you’ll own the operational foundation behind that work. You’ll connect HubSpot, Salesforce, product data, and analytics, build the systems and lifecycle infrastructure that turn signals into action, and give Marketing and our GTM partners trusted visibility into performance. Reporting to the Senior Director of Revenue Operations, you’ll translate the Marketing Operations vision into a roadmap and independently drive it forward while partnering closely with Growth, RevOps, Data, Product, and other GTM teams.

What You’ll Do

  • Execute on the Marketing Operations roadmap, translating broader Marketing and GTM priorities into scalable systems, processes, and programs.
  • Own our marketing automation platform end to end, including workflows, lifecycle stages, segmentation, forms, lists, email operations, data hygiene, deliverability, governance, and documentation.
  • Build and maintain the connection between marketing automation, Salesforce, product data, and analytics so we can understand and engage users throughout the customer journey.
  • Establish reliable attribution and measurement across marketing and product-led journeys, including UTM governance and connections between campaigns, signups, activation, conversion, and revenue.
  • Build reporting and self-service dashboards that give Marketing and GTM partners a trusted view of performance and support weekly, monthly, and executive-level decision-making.
  • Partner with Growth to operationalize lifecycle programs across email, in-product experiences, and sales-assist triggers, turning customer and product signals into scalable journeys from signup through activation and conversion.
  • Build experimentation infrastructure that allows marketers to launch, measure, and learn from tests without requiring engineering support for every experiment.
  • Own the operational health of the MarTech stack, including integrations, data flows, governance, vendor relationships, and periodic assessments of what we should keep, retire, consolidate, or integrate.
  • Establish scalable practices for high-volume email operations, including audience management, domain and inbox health, deliverability, and safeguards that protect the customer experience.
  • Turn large and sometimes ambiguous datasets into actionable recommendations, identifying points of friction or drop-off and partnering with Marketing, Growth, Product, Data, and RevOps on opportunities to improve conversion.
  • Own the Marketing Operations portion of the broader Marketing budget and evaluate technology investments based on business value, scalability, and ROI.
  • Explore emerging capabilities in AI-enabled marketing operations and AI visibility measurement, helping the team establish useful workflows and baselines as the space develops.

What You’ll Bring

  • 7+ years of experience in Marketing Operations or a closely related discipline, with experience operating independently in a complex B2B SaaS or product-led growth environment.
  • Deep experience with marketing automation platforms and CRM systems such as HubSpot, Marketo, Eloqua, and Salesforce, including lifecycle stages, campaign architecture, attribution, lead or account routing, and data governance.
  • Experience working with high-volume customer or prospect datasets and designing segmentation, lifecycle, and operational approaches that remain reliable at scale.
  • Significant experience operating high-volume email programs, with a practical understanding of deliverability, domain and inbox reputation, audience management, warming strategies, and the risks that emerge at large sending volumes.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to investigate complex datasets, identify meaningful patterns, question the quality of the underlying data, and turn findings into recommendations.
  • Experience building or operating lifecycle, nurture, or in-product engagement programs tied to measurable activation or conversion outcomes.
  • Systems thinking and experience designing integrations across marketing automation, CRM, product, analytics, and data systems.
  • Experience building measurement and experimentation infrastructure that enables other teams to operate and learn independently.
  • Strong GTM fluency and an understanding of how Marketing Operations, Growth, Sales, RevOps, Product, and Customer Success connect to customer experience and revenue.
  • Comfort using AI-enabled tools and workflows to accelerate your work while applying judgment to validate outputs and determine where automation is (and isn’t) appropriate.
  • Familiarity with product analytics tools such as Amplitude and experience with emerging AEO or AI-visibility tooling is helpful.
  • Experience working with contractors, agencies, or distributed partners is helpful but not required.
  • Familiarity with developer tools, web platforms, or another high-volume PLG business is useful, but we value relevant operating experience over category-specific expertise.

This Role Is a Great Fit If

  • You enjoy building the foundation, not just operating what someone else has already built. You’re energized by taking an imperfect system and creating something scalable, measurable, and trusted.
  • You’re comfortable moving between architecture and execution. You can define how a system should work and then get into the details yourself when necessary to make it work.
  • You thrive with significant autonomy. Given a goal and context, you investigate the problem, weigh tradeoffs, make a recommendation, and drive the work forward without needing a detailed playbook.
  • You genuinely enjoy data. Large, messy datasets make you curious, and you’re willing to dig until you understand what is happening and what the business should do about it.
  • You care deeply about operational quality. Data integrity, attribution, documentation, audience segmentation, and email deliverability aren’t afterthoughts—they’re part of building a trustworthy growth engine.
  • You balance speed with judgment. You know when to move quickly, when a shortcut creates unacceptable downstream risk, and when to challenge an approach that won’t scale.
  • You see AI as a way to amplify good judgment and increase leverage rather than a substitute for understanding the work.
  • You communicate clearly in an async, distributed environment and can build alignment across Marketing, Growth, Product, Sales, RevOps, and Data without relying on organizational authority.

Applying

Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? Please apply anyway!

When applying please include: 

A resume or short listing of your job history & skills (link to a LinkedIn profile would be fine). We appreciate a cover letter explaining why you would enjoy working in this role at Netlify to get to know you a bit better, though this is not required and will not impact your application. Our mission is to “build a better web” and that cannot be done without a diversity of skill sets, backgrounds and thoughts. 

Of everything we've ever built at Netlify, we are most proud of our team. Netlify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are devoted to building a team of people with diverse backgrounds and lifestyles. Driving equality empowers our team, enables us to innovate, and helps us maintain a more inclusive environment. We don’t discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, race, military/veteran status, citizenship, pregnancy status, or any other differences. If we can do anything to provide a better interview, i.e. accommodate a disability, then please let us know by emailing accommodations@netlify.com. 

About Netlify

Netlify is the most popular way to build, deploy, and scale modern web applications, empowering everyone from fast moving solo developers to enterprise teams. Millions of developers and organizations rely on Netlify as their platform of choice for composing web applications that are production ready, performant, and flexible. Now, as we embrace the next era of software development, we are embedding the same fluid, intuitive experience into the Agent Experience (AX), making it just as simple for intelligent agents to understand, interact with, and act on our platform as it is for developers. Whether your user is human or machine, Netlify ensures the path from idea to URL is seamless, fast, and deeply reliable.

We are a Series D company that has raised over $200M from investors such as Andreessen Horowitz, Kleiner Perkins, EQT, Bessemer, BOND, and Menlo Ventures. As a fully distributed company, we aim to create a company culture where the best idea can come from anywhere and strive to be thoughtful, compassionate, and collaborative in our work. If this sounds like something you’d like to be part of, we’re excited to connect with you!

At Netlify, we are committed to a compensation philosophy that prioritizes fairness and equity, positions our employee compensation competitively in the market, recognizes and rewards performance, and takes a comprehensive approach to our rewards package. We anchor our compensation philosophy on a market-based approach, therefore salary ranges may differ depending on the labor cost in a particular location. The salary provided is in addition to robust benefits and participation in Netlify’s equity plan. Our hiring range for this role is targeted at $155,000 - $210,000 for most US-based locations.  Candidates outside the US or in premium markets should consult with their Talent Acquisition partner regarding location-based ranges, as they may be higher or lower than the average US range listed. The starting pay will be determined based on multiple factors, including expertise and skills, market demands, experience, internal equity, and applicable geographic location. These compensation packages and ranges are subject to change and may be modified in the future.

Storyblok is hiring a Marketing Automation Manager to own the top of funnel systems and the campaigns that run through them: Pardot, the forms on the Storyblok website, list uploads, Clay, and the nurture programs, sequences and webinar flows built in Pardot. The role sends the campaigns, loads the lists and builds the forms day to day, and turns that repeat work into templates and automations so more of the week goes to lead scoring, routing, data quality and reporting. Sitting within Revenue Operations, this role works across Demand Generation, Events, Content, Partner Marketing, Sales Development, Sales Operations and Analytics, in a lean data team where the person pulls their own numbers and builds their own reports.

 ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

  1. Campaign operations
  • Build and send list emails and sequences in Pardot and Knak: webinar invites and follow ups, quarterly enterprise and marketer sequences, review asks, partner and event emails.
  • Build and run the nurture programs in Engagement Studio (welcome, post webinar, gated content, re-engagement), each by segment and lifecycle stage, and rebuild them as results come in.
  • Set up webinars end to end: registration form, Zuddl to Pardot sync, campaign IDs, reminders and follow up. Build form handlers, autoresponders and landing page forms on the Storyblok website.

  1. Marketing systems and integrations
  • Administer Pardot and its Salesforce sync: users, connectors, field mapping, campaign member status.
  • Own the links between Pardot, Salesforce, the website, Zuddl, Knak, Meta and Google Ads, and keep them documented.
  • Run Clay: enrichment waterfalls, list building, and the signal tables that feed BDR routing.
  • Evaluate, buy and renew the marketing tools.

Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. About the role

This role is responsible for Maven’s end-to-end benefits and payments platform, including eligibility and enrollments.  Maven’s benefits products should be easy to use for members, providers and employers. You will work closely with Engineering and Design teams, as well as with Maven’s Growth and Client Success teams, and with clients. 

This is a role for someone who has scaled a benefits or complex B2B2C operational product to the point where it runs quietly, and who has the client-facing judgment to decide what gets built, when, and for whom. 

What you'll do

jobs.title: Twikey: Senior Java Developer

Are you a driven back-end developer who doesn't wait for instructions, but is already thinking two steps ahead? Who experiments with new technologies and smart solutions alongside the job? Then we want to talk to you.

Straight forward but clear: Twikey isn't looking for someone to just execute. We're looking for someone who thinks, does and keeps going when the going gets tough.

Because fintech is evolving at breakneck speed. That calls for real ownership and for someone who can dive deep on the technical side to keep innovating and improving our platform. You get plenty in return, such as the freedom and responsibility to deliver your own projects. Thanks in part to our organisational structure, you can shape your ideas in the short term and see the results of your hard work quickly.

Driven by your passion for building scalable, performant and secure back-end systems, you continuously raise the bar for your own skills and for our product.

As a member of our development team you work closely with our CTO, 3 fellow developers and 2 testers on the core of our software application. A small, strong team in which you take on a role with real impact on the future of our product.

  • You focus on developing and improving the back-end of our platform, optimising the architecture and data processing while keeping the security and stability of our system in mind. This lets you put your technical skills to full use and come up with innovative solutions.
  • With your expertise you'll make valuable suggestions and streamline processes for all our stakeholders, so we can work more efficiently and achieve better results.
  • You provide technical support on integration projects with software houses, banks and large companies, solving complex technical problems. That gives you the chance to work on challenging projects and to get in touch with a wide range of technologies and industries.

Once you know our product inside out, there are plenty of challenging projects for you to help build.

What are we looking for in you?

  • You are driven, curious and enterprising. Not only in your job, but outside of it too. You have a pro-active attitude and are always a few steps ahead: you spot opportunities, grab them and get to work.
  • Technical challenges? You take them on, not because you have to, but because you want to learn. You're a self-starter and quickly get to grips with new technologies, languages or frameworks.
  • You understand that a good product is never "finished". You draw energy from that mix of creating and fine-tuning. You think along, question things and keep building new solutions.
  • You have experience using AI tools to build integrations. You're actively exploring how AI can contribute to smarter user experiences and more efficient software development. Experience with data analytics is an asset.
  • You therefore attach a lot of importance to the security, stability and reliability of a system and know what it takes to get there. You work in a structured, meticulous way and write code that is clean, reusable and easy to test.
  • You have demonstrable experience with Java, Go and the Spring framework. Experience with API integrations, web services, Linux or other relevant areas is a plus.
  • You have a deep understanding of databases. You don't just know how to use them, you know how they work. You have an opinion on structured, high-quality code, architecture and back-end technologies.
  • You have a very good command of English, for smooth collaboration with all colleagues and stakeholders. Dutch is an asset.
  • You are based in a time zone within one hour of CET, so your working day overlaps with the team's for the daily stand-ups and close day-to-day collaboration.
  • You can work independently and enjoy a small team where switching gears quickly, collaboration and knowledge sharing are central.

Twikey offers you:

  • An environment where challenge, innovation and autonomy come first.
  • The room to experiment, to challenge and to improve. And we expect you to really take that room.
  • An ideal setting if you want to grow fast and healthily, both technically and personally. Training, ownership, taking on new or additional roles based on your talents and interests, ... a lot is possible here, and you're at the wheel!
  • A complementary team of more than 35 colleagues who move forward together in a respectful and open atmosphere.
  • A motivating workplace with plenty of knowledge and expertise, shared both formally during the daily stand-ups and the weekly Friday call, and informally at the coffee machine.
  • Appreciation, openness and critical dialogue. Our Friction Hunter Trophy is an example: every month we celebrate the colleague who made the biggest difference for customers, teammates or internally. Your impact gets noticed!
  • A modern workplace with different zones (conference, connect, co-work, concentrate) in a recently built, industrial-style office building. Easy to reach by car, by bike and by public transport on the edge of Ghent, right next to the KBC tower.
  • A salary package tailored to your experience and skills, with plenty of extra-legal benefits, a collective bonus system and a cafeteria plan to convert your 13th month as you choose.
  • The chance to work in an innovative Belgian fintech scale-up that is active in several countries, in a sector that is growing fast!

A job ad doesn't tell you everything. Our colleagues tell you here what it's really like to work at Twikey.

jobs.title: Upgrade: AI Experience Engineer (Conversational AI)
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Canada (Remote)

About the Role:

An AI Experience Engineer owns the full lifecycle of the journeys our customers have with Upgrade's AI agent on chat, voice and email: creation, optimization, edge case handling and containment growth. They build journeys in Sierra's no-code tooling, partner with Upgrade's product groups to bring their servicing flows to the agent, and are accountable for whether the agent resolves the customer's issue safely, accurately and without a human.

We are hiring an AI Experience Engineer to own Upgrade's customer-facing AI agent. You will sit between engineering, product and customer operations. You will turn servicing workflows, such as making a payment, checking loan details, updating an address or enabling autopay, into production journeys and keep improving them after launch. You will build and own the journeys end to end, from first draft to steady state. The work is part builder, part analyst: design the flow, handle the edge cases, read the transcripts, and keep raising containment. Containment, CSAT, transfer quality and hallucination rate are your metrics.

Within your first year, you will own a portfolio of journeys across products (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, HELOC, Deposits) and help set the standards for how Upgrade builds, tests and ships AI experiences.

 

Our Core Technologies

Sierra Agent Studio (no-code journeys), Sierra simulations and conversation analytics, GraphQL and REST APIs (as journey tools), Genesys (contact center handoff), SumoLogic, Grafana, SQL, Javascript/Typescript, Claude and other LLM tools.

 

What You'll Do

• Journey creation: Design and build Sierra journeys in Agent Studio for chat, voice and email, from discovery with operations through production rollout

• Optimization: Review transcripts, recordings and analytics every week, find where conversations fail or transfer, and ship fixes to journey logic, instructions and knowledge

• Edge case handling: Map the unhappy paths (failed payments, mismatched identity, delinquent accounts, unsupported requests) and make sure each ends in a correct answer or a clean handoff

• Containment: Own containment and CSAT targets per journey, run staged rollouts (1% → 100%), and prioritize the work that moves those numbers most

• Product partnership: Work with product groups (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, Deposits) to scope new journeys, keep journeys current as products change, and define the APIs the agent needs

• Safety and compliance: Apply tiered authentication and step-up verification, verbatim compliance language and guardrails against hallucination and off-policy answers

• Handoffs: Design transfers to human agents in Genesys with accurate summaries and auth context

• Testing: Build simulation and regression suites so every journey change ships with evidence it did not break existing behavior

• Monitoring: Watch latency, errors and drop-offs in SumoLogic and Grafana, and own the alerts

• Voice tuning: Latency, filler phrases, interruptions, personality and tone

• Sierra relationship: Be the technical owner on our side, escalate platform issues and shape roadmap asks

 

What We Look For:

• 3–5 years of Frontend Software Engineering experience, or equivalent experience in Solutions Engineering, Conversational AI or Technical Product roles

• Working knowledge of how LLM agents behave: instructions, tool calls, knowledge retrieval, and where each one fails

• Experience building evaluations for non-deterministic systems: test sets, simulations, LLM-as-judge, regression gates

• Enough technical depth to read API specs, work with backend engineers on REST and GraphQL integrations, and reason about authorization and permission scopes

• Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to build and maintain coded journeys and integrate APIs within conversational AI platforms.

• Product and customer mindset: you understand ops procedures, you read transcripts, care about tone, and measure success by whether the customer's problem got solved

• Ownership in production: rollouts, monitoring, log analysis and incident response

• Clear writing and the ability to work with non-engineers in operations, compliance and legal

 

Nice To Have:

• Hands-on experience with Sierra Agent Studio, or a comparable no-code agent platform (Decagon, Ada, Kore.ai, Google CCAI, Amazon Lex/Connect)

• Voice AI experience: speech-to-text, text-to-speech, latency tuning, barge-in handling

• Contact center systems such as Genesys, and agent handoff design

• Background in fintech or another regulated industry (UDAAP, FDCPA, TCPA, PCI, SOC 2)

• Conversation design or UX writing experience

 

What We Offer You: 

• Competitive salary ($140K-$180K CAN) and stock option plan

• Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance 

• Flexible PTO

• Opportunities for professional growth and development
• Paid parental leave

• Health & wellness initiatives

jobs.title: Gemini: Lead, Technical Compliance
jobs.description:
Headquarters: New York, New York; Miami, Florida; Remote (USA)

About the Company

Gemini is a global crypto and Web3 platform founded by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss in 2014, offering a wide range of simple, reliable, and secure crypto products and services to individuals and institutions in over 70 countries. Our mission is to unlock the next era of financial, creative, and personal freedom by providing trusted access to the decentralized future. We envision a world where crypto reshapes the global financial system, internet, and money to create greater choice, independence, and opportunity for all — bridging traditional finance with the emerging cryptoeconomy in a way that is more open, fair, and secure. As a publicly traded company, Gemini is poised to accelerate this vision with greater scale, reach, and impact.

The Department: Compliance

Compliance at Gemini is a team dedicated to managing the next generation of financial crime prevention in a complex and evolving regulatory environment. We are a diverse group of technology, legal, and operational professionals who develop new approaches to solving classic problems using cutting edge tools and processes.

The Role: Lead, Technical Compliance

In this role, you will work with a team of experienced compliance professionals responsible for critical functions within the Compliance and AML/BSA/Sanctions program. This individual will be the key person responsible for helping to modernize the Compliance program through AI and automation initiatives, including the design and implementation of agentic AI workflows and solutions that leverage AI models. The role will ensure these solutions are scalable, secure, auditable, appropriately governed, and aligned with regulatory and business requirements. In addition, you will have responsibilities including, but not limited to, assessing transaction monitoring data ingestion, development and tuning of transaction monitoring scenarios, development of customer risk scoring models, enhancing Sanctions controls, reviewing name and transaction screening settings, development of reports to present to senior management, and other critical components/development of the compliance program that may arise from time to time. This position will have frequent interaction with firm senior management, third party vendors/auditors, and multiple departments within Gemini’s organization. 

Gemini’s Compliance team is constantly evolving and developing new operations and controls. In this role, you will contribute to that development by rolling-up your sleeves and building the future of money, while being an integral part of a best-in-class compliance department.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design, development, implementation, and ongoing enhancement of AI-enabled automation and agentic AI workflows across the Compliance Program.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage AI models, machine learning, and automation to improve the effectiveness, scalability, consistency, and efficiency of compliance processes and controls.
  • Evaluate emerging AI technologies and determine their suitability for compliance applications based on business value, risk, explainability, and implementation complexity.
  • Lead development and maintenance of Gemini’s transaction monitoring system, including data ingestion, development of new transaction monitoring scenarios, and optimization of transaction monitoring scenarios.
  • Support and maintain a customer risk scoring model that reflects Gemini’s risk-based approach and will drive periodic reviews and transaction monitoring (leading to effective customer segmentation).
  • Lead in enhancing sanctions controls, procedures, and tuning of thresholds. Maintain sanctions screening tool to stay up-to-date with list updates and relevant regulatory changes. 
  • Build real-time data and reporting solutions using Python or SQL that automate the capture of key management information and reporting in a scalable, efficient, and reliable manner.
  • Integrate and maintain external tools to enhance the Compliance Program.
  • Assist in developing enhancements to Gemini’s quantitative approach to its enterprise-wide AML/BSA risk assessment.
  • Partner with engineers, product managers, project managers, and analysts to deliver insights to Compliance.
  • Partner with Compliance, Engineering, Product, Data, Legal, and Information Security teams to translate business and regulatory requirements into scalable AI and technology solutions.
  • Establish appropriate governance and controls for AI-enabled solutions, including testing, validation, human oversight, data protection, auditability, documentation, and ongoing performance monitoring.
  • Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of AI and automation solutions, from requirements gathering and prototyping through implementation, production monitoring, and continuous improvement.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • BA/BS degree or international equivalent.
  • 7+ years of relevant work experience with compliance technology and data analysis within the financial services, digital asset and/or management consulting spaces. 
  • Advanced skills with Python and SQL are a must.
  • Experience in Databricks and Pyspark is good to have
  • Experience designing, developing, or implementing AI-enabled automation, agentic AI workflows, or other advanced technology solutions.
  • Experience leveraging AI models and data-driven technologies to solve complex business or operational problems.
  • Ability to translate business and regulatory requirements into technical requirements, solution designs, and measurable acceptance criteria.
  • Understanding of the software-development lifecycle, including testing, documentation, deployment, monitoring, and production support.
  • Comfort in a technology-forward company and facility with computer and web-based applications, including Microsoft Office, case management systems, and web-based databases.
  • Experienced in working collaboratively across different teams and departments.
  • Strong technical and clear business communication style.
  • Authorization to work in the United States and fluency in English.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Understanding of or familiarity with regulatory expectations and industry standards in relation to    AML/BSA/Sanctions regulations.
  • Exposure to blockchain tracing/analytics tools or blockchain concepts. 
  • Adaptability to an ever-changing environment and the capability to articulate thorough analysis to stakeholders.
  • Hands-on experience with generative AI, large language models, agentic workflows, prompt and context design, workflow orchestration, or AI-model evaluation.
  • Familiarity with responsible-AI principles and AI governance, including explainability, human oversight, privacy, security, auditability, and model-performance monitoring.
  • Experience implementing AI or automation solutions within financial services, compliance, risk management, or another regulated environment.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools or coding agents to support prototyping, testing, documentation, and solution delivery.
It Pays to Work Here
 
The compensation & benefits package for this role includes:
  • Competitive starting pay
  • A discretionary annual bonus
  • Long-term incentive in the form of a new hire equity grant
  • Comprehensive health plans
  • 401K with company matching
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Flexible time off

Salary Range: The base salary range for this role is between $140,000 - $200,000 in the State of New York. This range is not inclusive of our discretionary bonus or equity package. When determining a candidate’s compensation, we consider a number of factors including skillset, experience, job scope, and current market data.

In the United States, we offer a hybrid work approach at our hub offices, balancing the benefits of in-person collaboration with the flexibility of remote work. Expectations may vary by location and role, so candidates are encouraged to connect with their recruiter to learn more about the specific policy for the role. Employees who do not live near one of our hubs are part of our remote workforce. All employees, however, are required to onboard in-person at one of our office locations.

Equal Opportunity is the Law, and Gemini is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. If you have a specific need that requires accommodation, please let a member of the People Team know.

Why Talkspace? 

Talkspace is the most comprehensive and convenient way to take care of your mental health and wellness, focused on providing quality mental health services on your own terms.

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.

jobs.title: Gemini: Head of Consumer and Lending Compliance
jobs.description:
Headquarters: New York, New York; Miami, Florida; Remote (USA)

About the Company

Gemini is a global crypto and Web3 platform founded by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss in 2014, offering a wide range of simple, reliable, and secure crypto products and services to individuals and institutions in over 70 countries. Our mission is to unlock the next era of financial, creative, and personal freedom by providing trusted access to the decentralized future. We envision a world where crypto reshapes the global financial system, internet, and money to create greater choice, independence, and opportunity for all — bridging traditional finance with the emerging cryptoeconomy in a way that is more open, fair, and secure. As a publicly traded company, Gemini is poised to accelerate this vision with greater scale, reach, and impact.

The Department: Compliance

Compliance at Gemini is a team dedicated to managing the next generation of financial crime prevention in a complex and evolving regulatory environment. We are a diverse group of technology, legal, and operational professionals who develop new approaches to solving classic problems using cutting edge tools and processes.

The Role: Head of Consumer and Lending Compliance

In this role, you will lead the compliance program for Gemini’s deposit and lending products, including the first-in-class crypto rewards credit card and business credit card. You will be responsible for creating a comprehensive strategy to scale the program and support the business in delivering product features in a compliant and consumer-friendly way. The ideal candidate will have a deep knowledge of consumer finance regulations, be solutions-oriented, and have experience operating in a fast-moving environment. Superior communication skills are essential, as this individual will be required to communicate effectively with various stakeholders, including product, technology, legal, risk, as well as banking partners and regulators. This role reports directly to Gemini’s Global Chief Compliance Officer and has a direct line of communication to the Board.

Responsibilities:

  • Oversee the consumer compliance program in accordance with applicable laws and regulations (e.g., UDAAP, ECOA, FCRA, TILA, etc.)
  • Serve as the primary advisor to the credit card business and other horizon banking and lending products, providing guidance on new product development, product changes, and marketing initiatives
  • Manage a team of compliance professionals responsible for monitoring and testing, complaint management, third party oversight, issue management, compliance reporting, and customer-facing communications, among other areas 
  • Provide regular reporting to the Board of Managers and other governance committees 
  • Serve as the primary liaison between Gemini and its sponsor bank partner
  • Respond to internal and external audits, examinations, and regulatory inquiries related to credit card card operations
  • Oversee risk assessments for consumer banking products, identifying potential areas of risk and working cross-functionally to manage such risks
  • Serve as the Fair Lending Officer overseeing the company’s fair lending program
  • Ensure proper oversight of vendors and other third parties that present potential compliance or regulatory risk
  • Oversee remediation plans for high priority issues to ensure timely remediation and remedy of any compliance-related issues
  • Remain up-to-date on regulatory changes and landscapes, best practices and developments in the industry and ensure our implementation is both compliant and forward thinking
  • Provide timely and accurate advice and guidance to the Gemini’s staff on issues arising from compliance policy areas and subject matter within the responsibility of the Compliance Department

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree. CRCM or Juris Doctor preferred
  • 10+ years of compliance experience in credit, banking, fintech, or other financial regulatory compliance industry and at least 4+ years of experience overseeing a consumer compliance program is a must
  • Experience supporting a fast-scaling business
  • Possess deep knowledge and real world application of all lending and banking laws and regulations including UDAAP, TILA, TISA, ECOA, FCRA, EFTA, MLA, SCRA, GLBA, and CAN-SPAM 
  • Proven track record of providing oversight and strategic vision for the entirety of a Compliance Management System (CMS)
It Pays to Work Here
 
The compensation & benefits package for this role includes:
  • Competitive starting pay
  • A discretionary annual bonus
  • Long-term incentive in the form of a new hire equity grant
  • Comprehensive health plans
  • 401K with company matching
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Flexible time off

Salary Range: The base salary range for this role is between $150,500 - $215,000 in the State of New York. This range is not inclusive of our discretionary bonus or equity package. When determining a candidate’s compensation, we consider a number of factors including skillset, experience, job scope, and current market data.

In the United States, we offer a hybrid work approach at our hub offices, balancing the benefits of in-person collaboration with the flexibility of remote work. Expectations may vary by location and role, so candidates are encouraged to connect with their recruiter to learn more about the specific policy for the role. Employees who do not live near one of our hubs are part of our remote workforce. All employees, however, are required to onboard in-person at one of our office locations.

jobs.title: Samsara: Account Executive, Commercial ( West)
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote - US

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

This is a high energy role in which you will bring the Internet of Things to small to medium size customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be $5k to $20k, and typically involve proof of concepts, multiple stakeholders, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to owners, safety and operational managers.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. 
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work. 
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. 

In this role, you will: 

  • Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close.
  • Generate pipeline through strategic outbound prospecting, as well as receive inbound leads from our account development team.
  • Target accounts with 11-30 vehicles. 
  • Experience handling and owning transactional sales process with high volume demands.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • 1+ years of experience in a closing sales role

An ideal candidate has:

  • Proven track record of consistent quota achievement
  • Experience selling in the commercial space - small to medium deals sizes
  • Experience with high-volume cold calling
  • Experience in fast-paced, transactional sales
  • Must demonstrate a growth mindset and a willingness to be collaborative with your teammates and in your selling process

jobs.title: Talkspace: Client Support Supervisor
jobs.description:
Headquarters: New York, NY (Remote)

Our mission at Talkspace is to lower the barriers to mental healthcare. A critical piece to ensuring that everyone has access to therapy is partnering closely with the healthcare payer ecosystem to help our members get the care they need. Come join our mission of getting therapy in the hands of everyone!

We are looking for an experienced Client Support Supervisor to join our Client Support team. This role would be responsible for leading and developing a team of client support representatives, ensuring their success from their first day at Talkspace through their entire journey. This includes assessing their work, providing feedback, and driving performance and quality to achieve outlined success metrics. We are looking for someone who has experience developing a team and wants to bring their talents into a “for purpose” space. To work at Talkspace, you need to be as passionate as we are about our work, and excited to partner with us to achieve our mission of bringing quality mental healthcare to all.

*This is a remote position based on Eastern Time. Talkspace Headquarters is located in NYC*

 

What You'll Do

Supervisor responsibilities

    • Lead and develop a team of client support representatives from their first day at Talkspace through their last, ensuring the achievement of all outlined success metrics by frequently assessing their work and providing feedback aimed to maximize performance and quality.
    • Conduct 1:1 meetings and performance reviews with direct reports to help motivate them in their daily workload, while also driving team morale, and fostering career development.
    • Staff departmental specialty projects based on required skill set per focus area and volume needs; oversee the execution of duties + conduct periodic analysis of project effectiveness.
    • Report on your micro team’s production and quality performance on a weekly basis, noting trends and discussing required action plans for performance improvement.
    • Monitor departmental staffing levels through scheduling + gameplan mapping, suggest changes to help support daily operations, as needed.
    • Participate in the implementation of department performance metric targeting; work with key stakeholders to refine SLAs as business goals shift.
    • Design and execute corrective action plans for representatives not achieving outlined performance and quality metrics.
    • Participate in hiring of support representatives and assist new hires to ramp to production within outlined timeframes. 
    • Execute weekly payroll responsibilities.
    • Participate in leadership training, as assigned.

Tools

    • Actively monitor all CRM ticket inboxes/queues to ensure teams are meeting required first response times.
    • Effectively manage all leadership CRM inboxes/queues, directing and answering tickets, as needed.
    • Work closely with department leadership on strategies to maintain queues, assigning representatives where needed, to prevent increases to backlog.
    • Optimize internal use of QA software to record outcomes of coaching conversations for posterity and stakeholder visibility.
    • Assist client support sta with duties where required.

Department Optimization

    • Maintain advanced working knowledge of departmental policies, procedures, and voice of our customer (VOC).
    • Assist support representatives to investigate client reports of service interruptions, partner with internal teams on a resolution and communicate to support representatives to quickly resolve customer service complaints.
    • Assist with the development and implementation of company service policies and updates, draft documentation pertaining to customer service department activities, as needed.
    • Identify ongoing trends seen within client outreach and recommend enhancements to departmental policy, procedure, and company tools + resources, as needed.
    • Work with representatives to develop pathways for surfacing trends seen within client inquiries, opportunities for process improvement, and recommend ideas to improve SOPs.

Collaboration

    • Participate in interdepartmental meetings, providing insight into our end user and client support representative experience, as needed.
    • Partner with department Specialists/Leads to resolve escalated support tickets.
    • Initiate cross-departmental communication and coordinate to escalate and resolve customer issues.
    • Partner with Training, Quality + Content teams to ensure our knowledge materials + resources are adequate and allow staff to meet outlined performance expectations and service excellence standards.

Perform other related duties as assigned.

 

About You

  • A Bachelor's degree from a four-year college or university.
  • At least 2+ years direct experience managing and developing contact center support representatives, preferably in a telehealth environment.
  • Experience with Zendesk, Atlassian (Confluence, Jira), Stripe, and Looker, a plus.
  • Outstanding computer and technology skills.
  • Superb organizational and project management skills.
  • Outstanding communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Proven people leadership skills (coaching, staffing, planning).
  • Strong decision-making and process improvement skills.
  • Self-starter, able to work independently and prioritize effectively.
  • Excellent time management skill; strong sense of urgency.
  • Experience managing and developing standard operating procedures.
  • Passion for delivering a phenomenal customer experience!
  • Strong internet connection, required.

Bonus Points

  • Knowledge or experience with telehealth, telemedicine, or health plans
  • Experience (or strong interest) in working in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience with third parties/vendor management

 

Benefits 

  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision plans coverage since day one
  • Pre-tax benefits: HSA/ FSA
  • 401k Retirement Savings Program with matching up to 4%
  • Voluntary benefits including disability, basic life or pet insurance, etc.
  • Monthly Wellness Stipend to promote mental and physical self-care
  • Flexible PTO and Remote First Environment
  • Regular team events, including Wellness Workshops and Team Building Events
  • Free access to Talkspace products for you and one household member, as well as access to a friends and family discount!

 

Compensation

At Talkspace, we believe that pay transparency during the interview process is a critical part of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our salary bands are based on internal and external compensation benchmarks, which we regularly evaluate to ensure we pay competitively.

The base salary range for this role is between $65,000.00 and $72,500.00. Within the salary bands, leveling corresponds to each candidate’s relevant experience, skills as assessed during the interview process, education, and applicable certifications.

 

Why Talkspace? 

Talkspace is the most comprehensive and convenient way to take care of your mental health and wellness , focused on providing quality mental health services on your own terms. 

Our signature psychotherapy and psychiatry product connects individual users with a network of thousands of licensed mental health providers through an easy-to-use and HIPAA-compliant web and mobile platform. With Talkspace, users can connect their dedicated provider via live video, text, or phone. 

Our focus to help people feel better starts at Talkspace, where we connect and collaborate as a team to make the world a better place. Fun company-wide events, happy hours, wellness perks, flex PTO, access to Talkspace products, and competitive benefits are just some of the ways we make Talkspace a great place to work. Do you want to save the world? Come join us! 

 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Talkspace welcomes and celebrates talent from all backgrounds, perspectives, and walks of life to foster an innovative and diverse workforce. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification, if you believe you could make a great addition to this team. Come as you are and learn about the exciting opportunities on our team.

Individuals seeking employment at Talkspace are considered without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, marital, parental, veteran or military status, unfavorable military discharge, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

 

How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace? 

Diversity

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.

Belonging

Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.
