Nous is a household AI agent. It takes over the bills and admin people don't have time for and acts for them: switching energy, buying insurance, cancelling forgotten subscriptions, managing the family calendar. Nearly 250,000 UK households have signed up, and another joins every minute.

We think the real value of AI isn't writing amazing cover letters, it's doing useful things in the real world for real people. That's the hard part, and a brilliant product is only half of it. An energy switch takes weeks, so our agents run on long-running workflows, not a single chat turn. Cancelling a subscription means a browser agent handling the code Apple sends to your phone. Buying insurance meant getting our regulatory principal comfortable with an agent doing it end to end (a UK first), which comes down to knowing exactly when the LLM should hand over to rules because a mistake would cost someone real money.

We're about 30 people running one agent across energy, broadband, mobile, insurance, mortgages and subscriptions (with more being added), each with its own suppliers, rules and ways of going wrong. With far more problems than people, a person or small team owns each one end to end, from spotting it in the data or a customer conversation to shipping the fix. And because the agent acts, you find out quickly whether the fix worked.

Everyone builds here: a product engineer launched our subscription cancellation product within a couple of months of joining, and a PM rebuilt our WhatsApp agent.

And it's working. We're growing more than 20x year on year, with a market-leading NPS above +80, and we manage well over half a billion pounds of household spending. We've raised more than $30M from Heartcore, Mosaic and a who's who of entrepreneurs who founded Monzo, GoCardless, lastminute.com and Onfido. But the real draw is the team - ask anyone here why they joined and you'll get some version of "to do great work with really smart people".

The goal is household life that's simpler, cheaper and fairer, and most of that is still to build.

 

How we build (worth reading before the role)

How products get built is changing fast. With AI tooling, a PM can prototype, dig into production data and commit production code to get a change live all in an afternoon. An engineer can own a product area end to end and decide what to build next.

We're leaning into that. Our PMs lean into code and our engineers run products: one of our engineers owns the car insurance targets. We care about whatever gets the job done most effectively, regardless of once upon a time whose job it was meant to be.

We're moving fast and adapting as we go, and we don't have all the answers yet. What should a squad look like when everyone can build? Where does process still help, and where does it just slow you down? What's a PM for when an engineer can run the experiment themselves? We're working it out, and we want someone who is excited to be part of helping figure it out.

 

About the role

So where does a PM fit? A lot of our work still suits squads: clear targets, a few service lines and a team of engineers. Those squads need product managers to run them. All our roles in product overlap, but this one is centred on product management. If you’d rather spend all your time building, have a look at our Product Builder role.

You’ll take a squad responsible for a key section of our product and service lines and grow them: expand what they cover, understand the levers that drive their performance (automation, new suppliers, what we recommend to members) and increase their commercial value.

Being a Product Manager at Nous is one of the hardest roles we have. The product is complex and we move fast, so you need to be able to hold a lot of context. You'll switch between very different things all day: thinking about OKRs and the plan for the next couple of weeks one moment, getting a PR into production the next, while helping unblock an engineer.

That's also what makes it exciting.

You bring order to fast-moving work, get some sequencing in place so people aren’t each figuring it out on their own, evaluate what’s being shipped, own the reporting and keep the squad’s energy up. You won’t hesitate to make changes yourself, but you won’t be just another builder in the squad either: when you’re heads-down building, you can’t unblock anyone or bring the team together.

Growing a service line here means working across the boundary between product and commercial, so we’re particularly interested in PMs who’ve had real exposure to the commercial side of a business.

Our agent acts in the real world a lot, so saving someone money takes more than great product execution. We also need access to the best tariffs and suppliers, and we have to understand the regulation we operate in. And because Nous is an agent, your nice neat Amplitude funnels don't work: every user's journey can be totally different. So we're after PMs who are excited by everything it takes to make an agentic product work for real households, including the bits that wouldn't traditionally count as "product".

Worth being upfront: we can't tell you yet which service lines you'd own. It depends on the Venn diagram of your particular skill set and the problems we need to solve at the point you join.

 

What matters most

We need all of these at once:

  • Sharp. You pick things up quickly and enjoy hard problems. Given a messy one, you can lay out what you know and what you'd check first, then change your mind as new data turns up.

  • Adaptable. We’re working a lot of this out as we go, so the role and the squad will change, probably more than once. You enjoy that. You pick up whatever’s needed, PM work or not, and you work in the open: sharing rough thinking early and changing course when someone has a better idea.

  • Delivery. You bring order to a fast-moving squad: clear priorities, sensible sequencing, people unblocked quickly, and an honest look at whether what shipped actually worked.

  • Product craft. You find the real problem behind a request and make the trade-offs explicit. You care about the details of what our users actually see.

  • Commercial and analytical. You know what your area made last month, what moved it and what you'd do next, and you answer most of your own questions with data. You think in conversion, margin and lifetime value as readily as in features.

  • Energy. You've probably worked at a startup. You move fast, you're happy doing the unglamorous work yourself, and you'd rather ship this week's version than polish next quarter's.

And everyone builds here, PMs included. You'll use AI tooling (Claude Code or whatever gets it done) to prototype, dig into data and ship changes yourself. You don't need to be an engineer, but you shouldn't be scared of code.

 

What you'll actually do

  • Grow your service lines. Understand what really drives their performance, be able to measure it, and lead the squad to deliver it.

  • Set the squad's OKRs and roadmap, get the sequencing in place, and drive fast, efficient execution.

  • Evaluate what’s being shipped, and own the reporting: make sure the reports and the data behind them make sense.

  • Work across product and commercial: the suppliers and tariffs we can offer, the regulation we work within, and what that means for what gets built.

  • Run experiments, and unblock yourself on the analysis without always needing an analyst.

  • Get close to members and ops. Read the conversations, sit with the people handling the edge cases, and fix the parts of the journey where people drop out or get stuck.

 

About you

You'll likely thrive here if:

  • You've been a PM for a few years, ideally at a startup, and you've owned something with a number attached: revenue, conversion, retention.

  • You've worked on the commercial side as well as the product side: a P&L, a supplier or partner relationship, pricing, or a whole service line.

  • You're comfortable enough with data and code to unblock yourself.

Nice-to-haves:

  • You were a software engineer before you moved into product.

  • You've worked on a transactional or regulated product: insurance, fintech, energy, marketplaces.

  • You've built and shipped your own thing: a startup, a side project, an internal tool that took off.

This probably isn't for you if your PM experience is mostly roadmaps and stakeholder management at a big company, with no number you owned.

 

How we work

We keep the middle thin, on purpose. There's barely any middle management, which means fewer bottlenecks and room for exceptional people to have real impact without first being promoted into managing others. It's a real bet, not a free lunch. Instead of a manager buffer, you get lots of context and colleagues who help because they're invested, not because an org chart says so. If you need a clear remit handed down before you can move, this probably won't suit you.

Your first 90 days are built around getting you to real ownership safely: pairing when you want it, lots of context, and people who want you to ship. We celebrate the person who built the unglamorous version this week, not whoever thought of it first.

We're office-first, near Farringdon. We do a lot of our best thinking together and being in the same room helps, though we're pragmatic about heads-down work when you need it.

 

Remuneration and benefits

Compelling package including share options with life-changing upside. We've raised enough to pay real salaries, and we all share in the upside. If we win, we win together.

  • 🏢 A great office set up for collaborative work (we already need more whiteboards)

  • 💻 The equipment, setup and training you need to do your best work

  • 🤝 A high-context environment with real exposure to the big decisions, in the room when it happens

  • ☕ Very good coffee

  • 🍽️ A well-stocked kitchen (featuring a wildly popular toastie maker)

  • 🎉 Informal social every week, something bigger every month

  • ✈️ 33 days paid holiday (including bank holidays)

  • 💊 Health and dental cash plans, including an employee assistance programme

  • 🚴 Travel benefits, including the cycle-to-work scheme and season ticket loans

If you don't tick every box but think you'd be great at this, get in touch anyway.

jobs.title: Product ML Engineer
jobs.description:
About us

Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator's 2020 cohort, Photoroom is the leading visual solution for e-commerce.

We've raised Series B funding and reached 300+ million users worldwide, processing over 5 billion images annually and serving both small businesses and major enterprises like Amazon, DoorDash, and Decathlon through our mobile app, web platform, and API.

We're a team of 100+ passionate builders giving e-commerce businesses superpowers to create visuals that help them grow, making the hardest parts of selling online disappear. We focus on craft, innovation, and collaboration to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.

Role Summary

We're looking for a Product ML Engineer to join one of our product experience teams — SMB, Scaler or Enterprise — and own the ML side of short, high-impact projects.

You'll work on focused ML problems with a clear product outcome, sometimes fine-tuning one of our models, sometimes integrating the best externally available model, but always choosing the fastest and most effective path to customer value.

You'll bring the technical depth of an Applied Scientist while operating with the pace and pragmatism of a product engineer. You'll own the journey from framing the problem through to shipping, measuring and iterating on the feature in production.

This is not a research role. Your time horizon is weeks rather than quarters, and success is measured by what reaches users and the impact it creates.

About the role

  • Embed directly within a product team. Work closely with the SMB, Scaler or Enterprise team on focused ML problems tied to clear customer and business outcomes.

  • Own ML projects end to end. Frame the problem, choose the approach, execute the plan, ship the feature and monitor its performance in production.

  • Make the build vs. buy decision. Determine when to fine-tune or build a model yourself versus integrating an external model, API or existing library.

  • Move from idea to production quickly. Work on projects scoped in weeks rather than quarters, prioritising rapid iteration and customer impact.

  • Work closely with the ML team. Leverage shared infrastructure, evaluation tooling and expertise while remaining embedded in the product team's priorities and cadence.

  • Stay close to users. Get rapid feedback from customers, monitor how people use what you've shipped and use those insights to drive the next iteration.

  • Balance technical depth with pragmatism. Know when deeper modelling work is necessary and when an existing solution is already good enough to ship.

  • Write production code. Work directly in the product team's codebase rather than operating primarily through research notebooks and experiments.

  • Own quality in production. Build sound evaluations, monitor performance and investigate failures once the feature is live.

About You

  • You've shipped ML into production. You have 2+ years of hands-on experience building and shipping ML-powered products, with strong experience in PyTorch or equivalent frameworks such as TensorFlow or JAX.

  • You have applied-science depth. You can fine-tune vision or diffusion models, design meaningful evaluations and debug training runs when necessary.

  • You're a pragmatic builder. You care about solving the customer's problem rather than proving that your own model is the best approach. You'll happily use an external model, API or existing library when that's the fastest route to value.

  • You're product-minded. You measure success through shipped features, user behaviour and business outcomes rather than papers or benchmarks alone.

  • You're comfortable in production codebases. You can move between experimentation and production engineering, writing maintainable code that lives inside a real product.

  • You have strong ownership. You're comfortable taking an ambiguous ML problem, deciding what matters, choosing an approach and driving it through to production.

  • You iterate quickly. You enjoy short feedback loops and would rather ship something useful, learn from users and improve it than spend months optimising something that hasn't reached production.

  • You're curious and collaborative. You can both explain your expertise and learn from the deep technical expertise around you. You value knowledge sharing and humility.

  • You're fluent in English. French isn't required.

Nice to have: experience shipping generative image models or diffusion models into production; experience evaluating third-party AI APIs against internal alternatives; experience working in a fast-growing startup or directly within a product team.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary + meaningful equity

  • Hybrid working from our Paris headquarters

  • Visa sponsorship and relocation support up to €10,000

  • MacBook Pro and full home office setup

  • 30 days annual leave

  • Private healthcare

  • Regular company off-sites and team retreats

  • International English-speaking team

  • Language lessons in English and French

Hiring Process

  1. Screening with an ML Researcher / Engineer

  2. Home technical assignment and review with the team

  3. Culture fit interview and meet the team

  4. Reference check and offer

Support: We value diversity and aim to create an inclusive experience for all applicants. Please let us know if there's anything we can do to make the process more accessible for you.

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging

We're committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at work. We believe our company and culture are strongest when composed of diverse experiences and backgrounds.

That's also why we have flexible working hours, trust people to work in a hybrid environment, and extended parental leave.

All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

jobs.title: GTM Associate
jobs.description:
GTM Associate

London, 4x days per week in-office

Vega is looking for A-players to help build the commercial engine and take on a revenue-driving seat. You will be a clients’ very first touchpoint with Vega; running outbound, supporting growth and marketing initiatives, and building systems that support hyper-growth.

About Vega

Vega is transforming the way private markets operate. Alternative asset management is one of the most influential forces in the global economy, with over $20TN in assets today. Over the next five years, the industry is set to grow 3x, but GPs are facing challenges around their ability to handle the investment flows that are coming in. GPs have been completely underserved by innovation, particularly on the investor relations side.

Vega built the industry’s first AI-native operating system, where all client work gets done - from the start of an investor’s journey to its end. We are rethinking how work gets done in private markets from first principles: the opportunity is big, but it’s also niche, high-stakes, and difficult to get right.

Who we are

We are still at the beginning of our journey. Vega was founded by former investors at Elliott and KKR, and built by talent from the world’s leading technology and financial services firms - including Trade Republic, Revolut, Goldman Sachs, BCG, and more. We have raised $30M so far, with the backing of Apollo, Motive Partners, and 60+ senior executives from the industry. Today, we have over $300B AUM and 30,000 users on the platform, and we have much more left to do.

How we do it

Vega is a fast-growing startup. We want to make this a career-accelerating place for people with the ambition to build something big. If the below sounds appealing, it could be for you:

  1. We do not seek consensus. You will be expected to voice opinions and take initiative. Vega's best people do not wait to be told what to do before finding solutions to problems they have spotted.

  2. We believe bureaucracy is the killer of progress. We are focused on creating the minimum viable process to operate with quality at speed.

  3. We prioritise talent over tenure. There is no promise of progression without performance – we assess and reward people on impact above all else.

  4. We iterate fast. We make decisions amid ambiguity and with imperfect information, and we strive to balance committing to a hypothesis with iterating at low ego.

  5. We play to win. Expectations, intensity and ambition are very high, with every single colleague contributing to Vega's success. This often will not be a 9-5.

We know that this culture won’t be for everyone, and we endeavour to make this clear from the beginning of the recruiting process out of respect for your time. Ask yourself whether the above sounds exciting to you in practice every day, and if it does, we would love to hear from you.

Who succeeds in this role

We look for people who match our ambition levels, and then raise it further.

In this role, you will:

  • Be a client’s first touchpoint with Vega - this means being a credible counterpart to senior people at multi-billion dollar managers

  • Work directly with the Head of Strategy and Growth and the CEO to find angles and drive deals forward from start to close

  • Own top-of-funnel pipeline generation: targeting, outbound, qualification, and building the systems around this motion

  • Help build the commercial playbook as you go: taking an operational and systematic lens to turn learnings into a discipline that the team can follow

  • Support the broader growth surface: events, partnerships, content, and marketing

What we look for:

  • 2+ years in investor relations / finance, MBB, or a commercial/operational role at a fast-paced startup

  • Experience in private markets, particularly around investor relations workflows, is a strong plus

  • Strong interpersonal and relationship building skills, as well as analytical instincts

  • Genuine tolerance for repetition and rejection - this is some of the highest impact work you can do for the company, but it’s also high volume and requires scrappiness

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills when interfacing with clients who have a very high standard for output and attention to detail

  • Creativity and a bias to action, particularly when supporting with broader growth/marketing topics

Why join us?

  • You will help define the transformation of one of the most influential industries of our time with AI, working alongside an ambitious and dedicated team

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Benefits including medical insurance, gym membership, learning budget, and more

jobs.title: (Senior) Finance Manager (all genders)
jobs.description:
At Klim, we work with farmers and food companies to make regenerative agriculture scalable and financially rewarding for farmers. Through our platform, we help farmers restore soil health, increase biodiversity and capture carbon while creating new, reliable income streams.


We’re a Berlin-based AgriTech startup backed by $22M in Series A funding, partnering with global food leaders such as Nestlé and Kaufland to reduce emissions across their supply chains and build long-term resilience. Since 2020, we’ve supported 3,500 farmers managing over 900,000 hectares.

If you’re passionate about building a sustainable food system and driving real climate impact, join us and help create a healthier planet!

Your mission:

As our (Senior) Finance Manager, you will run all aspects of Finance at Klim. From HGB accounting and the monthly and annual close, through day-to-day financial operations, to audits, controlling and finance projects — you own the full breadth of the finance function end-to-end. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with unusually broad responsibility: you are the person who keeps our financial engine room running accurately, reliably and on time, and who continuously makes it simpler, faster and more automated. You are supported by a working student whose work you steer, and you report directly to our COO.

This role is a great fit for you if you are a finance all-rounder who wants genuine ownership of the entire finance function and the opportunity to make a real impact from day one. With a broad mix of strategic, tactical and operational responsibility, you’ll have plenty of room to shape how we work, improve what’s already there and build an automated Finance function.

Your responsibilities:

  • Own our HGB-compliant accounting: run the month-end and year-end close and deliver accurate, timely financial statements with our external accountants.

  • Run financial operations end-to-end: accounts receivable and payable, tax-compliant invoicing, payment runs, expense flows and cash management.

  • Manage statutory reporting and tax topics (e.g. Jahresabschluss / annual financial statements, VAT) together with our external tax advisors.

  • Prepare and manage the annual audit: audit files, documentation and communication with auditors.

  • Support controlling and strategic finance topics: management reporting, analyses and spreadsheet-based models that inform business decisions.

  • Be the driving force behind the introduction of innovative AI-based processes, building a state-of-the-art efficient and effective finance setup.

  • Manage and develop our finance working student.

Your profile:

  • 3–5 years of experience in accounting and/or finance roles.

  • Solid HGB accounting experience, including month-end and year-end close.

  • Hands-on experience in financial operations (invoicing, payments, expense management, cash).

  • Very diligent and reliable: high attention to detail, structured, and on top of many short- and long-term deadlines.

  • You are highly autonomous and have a hands-on mentality: you are comfortable owning the full breath of the finance function. You take responsibility for getting things done and you are very good at collaborating with internal and external stakeholders.

  • Experience driving innovation and AI in Finance: You have designed, optimized and automated processes and are confident using AI tools.

  • Fluent in German and English (written and spoken).

Your benefits:

  • Opportunity: Be part of our journey from the very beginning, working on an equal footing with the leadership team to build a new company.

  • Impact: Make a daily and active contribution to combating climate change, promoting consumer education, and fostering fair conditions for our climate-conscious farmers.

  • Autonomy: Take ownership of your projects and enjoy a high degree of creative freedom.

  • Flexible work model: At Klim, we foster a flexible, hybrid work approach and facilitate remote work (within the EU). It is advantageous for this role if you live in Berlin or can be present in our office regularly.

  • Additional benefits for Germany-based employees: We offer a subsidy for a membership in Urban Sports Club or the Deutschlandticket, a company pension scheme, plus team lunches (if based in Berlin) and regular team events.

At Klim, we believe that a thriving workplace is built on the diverse backgrounds, talents, and perspectives of our team. We grow stronger together by embracing and building on each individual’s unique strengths.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. All hiring and personnel decisions are made solely based on qualifications, performance, and the needs of the company - ensuring fairness and equal opportunity for all.

If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. You might be the perfect fit for our team in ways you don’t yet realize!

👷🏻‍♀️ What we do 👷🏻‍♀️

At Emidat, we are building the first climate-native product management system for building material manufacturers. We aim to decarbonise building materials, making up 11% of global GHG emissions. We collect data from physical production processes, generate a digital product passport with verified environmental data and make it usable along the value chain. In short: One solution to assess, design, buy, sell and manage products - with environmental impact at the core.

With this, we are building the digital infrastructure to make it faster, easier, and more sustainable to build the world around us.

Find out more about us, the team and our values here.

What you will work on

Your mission

Accelerate Emidat’s growth by acquiring new leads, being Emidat’s first face to the customer and building our predictable, repeatable revenue engine. Work closely with the Sales Development Rep and Account Executive on the go-to-market plan for the country.

As our Sales Intern (Turkish), you will be driving our revenue pipeline focussing on the Turkish market. In this role, you are the first face and voice to our customer, so this role is perfect if you love being around people and have a talent for convincing, understanding and solving their problems.

At Emidat, we see top-of-funnel as equally important if not more so than closing deals. Without leads, there is no revenue. We are searching for a hungry sales person, who is not scared of approaching people actively and being the face of Emidat. Your customers are manufacturers, so you shouldn’t be shy and bring a curiosity for material manufacturing and construction (note: we think visiting steel, cement and glass plants is the coolest thing in the world next to customers holding their product into the Teams call to show us how it’s done).

Your challenge:

Joining our sales development team involves:

  • Customer Pipeline Development: Build and nurture our customer pipeline, from initial prospecting to booking a demo.

  • Go-to-Market Strategy: Develop and fine-tune our go-to-market strategy, ensuring alignment with our company objectives.

  • Revenue Engine: Build and improve our repeatable and predictable revenue engine.

  • Team Building: Play a key role in building and growing the sales team leading us to 3mn ARR.

Your first 3 months at Emidat (sample)

Any Emidavinci starts with a detailed 3-month OKR sheet, which helps to build clarity and accountability from day 1. This is only a high-level overview how this can look like as a Sales Development Executive, but you will find many of the points on your 3-month list in your first week again.

1. Deeply understand our customer and market

  • Customer Mastery: Call customers, attend conferences and deeply understand our target customers.

  • Discovery Calls: Conduct your first discovery calls and schedule at least 20 demos

  • Demo Shadowing: Shadow at least 10 demos to learn how we close deals.

2. Plan and conduct your own outbound campaigns

  • Campaign Ownership: Design your own outbound campaign (incl. list, workflows and sequences). Plan and own 3 campaigns in total

  • RevOps: Analyze and improve email open/reply rates (target: 25%+ open rate, 5%+ reply rate)

  • Outbound prospecting: Execute on the campaigns (e.g. follow-up with calls, send emails/LinkedIn requests)

3. Get to know and improve our revenue engine design

About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

We offer a highly competitive compensation package with On-Target Earnings (OTE), designed to reward high performance and results. This includes a strong base salary complemented by an uncapped commission structure, meaning there is no limit to what you can earn — your success directly drives your income. Top performers have the opportunity to significantly exceed OTE, supported by a transparent, performance-driven bonus plan that truly rewards achievement.

 

Building on this performance-driven culture, not every candidate ticks every box — and that’s why we value individuals with a growth mindset who bring potential, initiative, and a willingness to learn.

Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.
At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

We are looking for a Managing Director to own and drive end-to-end Go-To-Market (GTM) performance for one of Aircall’s most strategic countries.
 
This is an end-to-end GTM leadership role with accountability across pipeline generation, sales, and account management, in a high-growth context, at a turning point in Aircall’s trajectory.
 
We are searching for a hands-on, execution-driven leader who combines strategic clarity with operational rigor, builds high-performing teams, and consistently turns ambition into results — while keeping things human, fun, and fast.
 
 
Key Responsibilities

Own and drive end-to-end GTM performance
  • Full ownership of the regional GTM strategy and execution, from pipeline generation to renewals and expansion
  • Accountability for pipeline creation, bookings, ARR growth, retention, and expansion
  • Ensuring tight alignment with Marketing, Partnerships, Product at a regional/ global level

    • Execute ambitious growth targets
  • Translate company-level growth objectives into clear local plans and execution priorities
  • Drive consistent over performance through strong operating cadence, forecasting, and performance management

    • Lead AI-driven growth
  • Make Aircall’s AI Product Suite a central pillar of the local GTM motion
  • Ensure teams are equipped to sell business outcomes and AI-driven value, not just features
  • Identify and unlock new expansion levers through AI (upsell, cross-sell, new segments)

    • Collaborate cross-functionally
  • Partner closely with Product to influence roadmap priorities and bring customer insights to AI innovation
  • Work hand-in-hand with Marketing to drive demand generation, positioning, and regional GTM campaigns
  • Develop and scale Partnerships as a strategic growth lever, including tech, channel, and ecosystem partners

    • Build and inspire high-performing teams
  • Lead, coach, and develop GTM teams across the region
  • Foster a culture of excellence, ownership, and accountability
  • Attract and retain top talent in a highly competitive environment
    • Why join us?

    🚀 Key moment to join Aircall in terms of growth and opportunities
    💆‍♀️ Our people matter, work-life balance is important at Aircall
    📚 Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit
    🌍 45+ Nationalities: cosmopolite & multi-cultural mindset
    💶 Competitive salary package & benefits

    DE&I Statement: 
    At Aircall, we believe diversity, equity and inclusion – irrespective of origins, identity, background and orientations – are core to our journey. 

    We pride ourselves on promoting active inclusion within our business to foster a strong sense of belonging for all. We’re working to create a place filled with diverse people who can enrich and learn from one another. We’re committed to ensuring that everyone not only has a seat at the table but is valued and respected at it by providing equal opportunities to develop and thrive.  

    We are strongly committed to hiring a diverse and multicultural team and we encourage applications from traditionally underrepresented backgrounds.

jobs.title: Tenable Architect  – Relocation provided
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced vulnerability management specialist with strong hands-on knowledge of Tenable platforms? For one of our valued clients in Amsterdam, we are looking for a Tenable Architect / Administrator to design, manage, and optimise an enterprise vulnerability scanning environment.
 
In this role, you will be responsible for the architecture and administration of Tenable Security Center, Tenable Vulnerability Management, and Nessus scanners across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. You will define scanning strategies, maintain platform performance, automate operational tasks, and work with security and infrastructure teams to prioritise and remediate vulnerabilities.
 
Why Join Us? 
 
At Wypoon Technologies, you’ll work on dynamic projects for industry leaders such as Heineken, ING, ASML, Philips, and Shell, tackling exciting challenges and delivering tailored enterprise solutions. 
 
Here’s what makes us stand out: 
✔ Impactful Work: Shape the future of our clients’ digital landscapes. 
✔ Innovative Environment: Collaborate within a supportive team that values learning and growth. 
✔ State-of-the-art technology: Access the latest tools and platforms. 
✔ Global Opportunities: Are you dreaming of living and working in the Netherlands or Belgium? We provide full support with visa processes, making your transition smooth and hassle-free! 
  

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, implement, and maintain the enterprise Tenable architecture.
  • Deploy and manage Tenable Security Center, Tenable Vulnerability Management, Nessus Managers, and Nessus scanners.
  • Configure scan zones, repositories, scan policies, credentials, users, roles, and access permissions.
  • Define scanning strategies for on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.
  • Monitor platform health, capacity, availability, and scanning performance.
  • Manage platform upgrades, plugin updates, patches, and scanner maintenance.
  • Troubleshoot failed scans, connectivity problems, authentication issues, and performance bottlenecks.
  • Analyse vulnerability findings and support risk-based prioritisation using CVE, CVSS, and related methodologies.
  • Generate vulnerability reports, dashboards, and remediation tracking information.
  • Automate administrative tasks and reporting using REST APIs, Python, PowerShell, or Bash.
  • Integrate Tenable with platforms such as ServiceNow, Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Active Directory, and other ticketing or SIEM solutions.
  • Support infrastructure and application teams with vulnerability remediation, validation, audits, and compliance activities.
    •  

    Requirements
  • Strong hands-on experience with Tenable Security Center, Tenable Vulnerability Management/Tenable.io, and Nessus.
  • Experience designing or administering enterprise-scale vulnerability management platforms.
  • Proven experience deploying, configuring, and troubleshooting Nessus scanners.
  • Good understanding of vulnerability management processes, remediation workflows, and risk-based prioritisation.
  • Knowledge of CVE, CVSS, CIS Benchmarks, security controls, and compliance frameworks.
  • Experience configuring scan policies, scan zones, repositories, credentials, roles, and permissions.
  • Basic to intermediate scripting experience with Python, PowerShell, or Bash.
  • Experience working with REST APIs and JSON data for automation and reporting.
  • Exposure to vulnerability scanning in AWS, Azure, GCP, or hybrid cloud environments.
  • Experience integrating Tenable with ServiceNow, SIEM platforms, Active Directory, or ticketing systems.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and stakeholder communication skills.
  • Proficiency in English at B2 level or higher, both spoken and written.
  • Relevant certifications such as Tenable Certified Professional, Security+, CEH, CISSP, or an Azure/AWS security certification are preferred.

    • What We Offer
  • Competitive Compensation: Salary tailored to your skills and experience. 
  • Generous Time Off: 25 paid vacation days (based on a 40-hour work week). 
  • Relocation Support: A relocation and travel budget to ease your transition. 
  • Tax Benefits: Eligibility for the 30% ruling. 
  • Travel Reimbursement: We've got your daily commute covered. 
  • Top-Notch Equipment: A high-quality device to ensure you work efficiently. 
  • Professional Development: Financial support for certifications, technical training, and language courses—because we value your long-term career growth. 
  • Family: Visa sponsorship for your partner and children under 18. 
  • Temporary Accommodation: Stay in temporary housing while we help you find your permanent home. 
  • Comprehensive Relocation Assistance: Extensive support to help you settle in smoothly. 
  • Community & Fun: Enjoy team events and connect with developers from around the globe! 
    • Join Wypoon Technologies, where your expertise will thrive, your ideas will be valued, and your career will reach new heights.
    Apply now and make a real impact!

jobs.title: Senior Chief Platform Architect - 801
jobs.description:
We are seeking an Chief Platform Architect in our CO, MN, or UK locations.
 
As the Chief Platform Architect for the Quantum Software Developer Platform, you will act as the technical authority for the design Quantinuum’s developer platform: access portals for quantum computers, hybrid work-flow orchestration, tooling access, documentation, and security. You will work with other leaders on hardware-software co-design efforts, ensuring our platform is scalable and enabling of our quantum processors. You will mentor senior engineers, ensure excellent coding standards, and help define and execute on the technical roadmap to translate business needs into robust, production-ready systems.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Own the design and specifications of a high-performance developer platform.
  • Refine quantum computer access API and web portal architecture for performance, scalability and multi-region operation
  • Transform web portal into an application development and delivery framework by leveraging cloud-based hybrid workflow engine and reusable quantum/classical application components
  • Define standard interfaces for hosting application components and building applications by both internal and external developers
  • Ensure the security and reliability of the platform as it scales up
  • Deliver customizable cloud-based hybrid applications to end users
  • Work across the business to help define and maintain the technology roadmap, translating business goals into technical requirements and evaluating new technologies.
  • Foster a culture of excellence by establishing best coding practices, performing architectural reviews, and mentoring senior software engineers.

    • YOU MUST HAVE:
  • 25+ years in software engineering, with at least 5+ years in a senior architect or lead role, specifically within developer platforms.

    • WE VALUE:
  • Deep knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and cloud-native solutions.
  • Expertise in CI/CD pipeline design, developer portals (e.g., Backstage), and observability tools.
  • Demonstrated success in designing large-scale software systems
  • Proven ability to lead architectural work for large-scale projects and influence teams without direct authority.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; Master’s or PhD preferred.
    Preferred Qualifications
  • Prior experience in the design and architecture of developer platforms
  • Experience in building platform engineering teams from the ground up.
  • Background in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE).
  • Record of publication or patents in quantum computing.

    • Quantinuum is a leading quantum computing company delivering a full stack platform designed to make quantum computing deployable in real-world environments. With active engagements spanning pharmaceuticals, material science, financial services, government, industrial sectors, and leading academic and research institutions worldwide, we are helping organizations unlock the transformative potential of quantum computing. 

    Our global team of more than 800 employees includes many of the world's leading scientists, engineers, and researchers, with more than 70% of our technology team holding advanced degrees at the Master's or PhD level. Headquartered in Broomfield, Colorado, Quantinuum operates across the United States, United Kingdom, Germany, Japan, and Singapore. 

    By joining Quantinuum, you’ll help shape the future of quantum computing, pushing the limits of technology, and making the impossible possible.

    What’s in it for you?

    We believe our people are our greatest strength and offer a comprehensive rewards package that supports your professional growth, well-being, and long-term success.

    • Competitive compensation and the opportunity to work on groundbreaking technology
    • Flexible work arrangements that support work-life balance
    • Employer-subsidized medical, dental, and vision insurance
    • 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match and student loan repayment benefit
    • Equity opportunities
    • Generous paid time off, sick leave, and 12 paid holidays annually
    • Paid parental leave
    • Employee discount programs 

    Equal Opportunity Employer

    Quantinuum is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace where all employees and applicants are treated with respect and provided equal opportunities regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, ancestry, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

    Know Your Rights: Workplace discrimination is illegal. For more information about Quantinuum, please visit our website.

jobs.title: Senior Specialist, T2 / Target2 Payment Operations
jobs.description:
About Finom
 
Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.
 
We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.
 
Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.
 
At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

Senior Specialist, T2 (Target2) Payment Operations 

Location: Remote in Netherlands, Spain, Cyprus or Poland

The role

We’re moving from indirect to direct participation in TARGET2 (T2), and we need someone to own the operational side end to end. You’ll design and document the Payment Operations processes, validate them in the August UAT, cut over BIC by BIC, and then run them as business-as-usual. You’ll be the operational contact for the T2 scheme, DNB and our partner banks.

What you’ll do

  • Own core payment processes: SCT / SCT Inst recalls, investigations (including pacs.028), SWIFT enquiries (MT199/MT999, RFIs), missing or incoming funds, and rejects, returns and refunds.
  • Run the T2 platform day to day: work in the T2 GUI (U2A/A2A), maintain CRDM reference data, and set up four-eyes controls and the manual-vs-automated split.
  • Manage the migration: move traffic from BNP Paribas to direct participation, with every payment traceable by BIC and path, and define when each BNPP-dependent step can be retired.
  • Cover reconciliation and liquidity: be the Payment Ops link to the reconciliation team (funding and defunding stay with Finance Ops/Treasury).
  • Handle incidents and contingency: build the incident process around DNB, FIS and TARGET escalation routes, own Payment Ops’ role in DNB reporting, and define the ECONS II contingency approach.
  • Coordinate with others: work with the Eurosystem, DNB, SWIFT/NEXI, FIS and correspondent banks, and partner with Product and Engineering to specify how the platform should behave.

What success looks like

  • Every direct-participation process has an owner, documented procedures, and passing UAT evidence.
  • The migration causes no impact on customers, and Customer Support has clear guidance.
  • After go-live, T2 runs as stable BAU with no remaining BNPP operational dependency.

What we’re looking for

  • Hands-on experience with T2 / TARGET Services (RTGS, TIPS), including the GUI and U2A/A2A actions
  • Around 2-3+ years in payment operations at a bank, EMI or PSP, ideally with SEPA schemes (SCT, SCT Inst)
  • Familiarity with investigations, recalls, returns and SWIFT / ISO 20022 messaging
  • Experience writing SOPs and controls, or the ability to pick it up quickly
  • Comfort working with regulators, partners and technical teams
  • Enough ownership to make sign-off and escalation decisions with support from the team
  • Fluent English

Nice to have

  • Experience with CRDM reference-data maintenance
  • Involvement in a direct-participation onboarding or sponsor-bank migration
  • Knowledge of DNB / TARGET-NL conditions, IPR, PSD2, or ECONS II contingency processes
What You Will Get In Return
 
Make a genuine impact on the product
 
Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product.
 
Work in the EU
 
Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.
 
Become a stock options holder
 
Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.
 
Receive unwavering support and care
 
Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.
 
Work & Swim program
 
Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views.
 
Equal Opportunity Statement 
 
At Finom, we're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We embrace diversity and invite applications from all walks of life. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

  • AI-powered accounting automation
  • Build polished, responsive UIs using Jetpack Compose.

  • Collaborate closely with Backend, QA, Design, and Product — you'll be shaping solutions end-to-end, not just implementing specs.
  • Drive technical decisions within your domain, challenge assumptions when needed, and proactively identify opportunities to build better.

    You're pragmatic and have a proven track record of shipping products that matter. You communicate clearly across disciplines and thrive in a cross-functional environment where everyone is solving the same customer problem together.

  • Strong knowledge of Kotlin (Java knowledge is a plus) and 5+ years of commercial Android development.
  • Deep understanding of OOP, SOLID, and Clean Architecture.
  • Solid experience with presentation layer patterns — MVI, MVVM, and MVP — and the ability to choose the right one for the context.
  • Hands-on experience with our core stack:
  • Reactive programming & async: RxJava, Kotlin Coroutines / Flow
  • Dependency injection: Dagger 2, Hilt, or Koin
  • Networking: Retrofit
  • Navigation: Cicerone, Jetpack Navigation Component
  • Modern UI: Jetpack Compose
  • Practical experience with Firebase (FCM, Analytics, Crashlytics).
  • Experience with Feature-module architecture in production.
  • Confidence with Git / GitLab, including setting up and maintaining GitLab CI/CD.
  • A builder's mentality — you care about the product, the users, and the outcomes, not just the code.
  • Clear, concise communication in English across technical and non-technical audiences.

    • Nice to Have
  • Background in fintech or experience with financial products — you understand the stakes.
  • Solid grasp of mobile security best practices (especially critical in our domain).
  • Experience profiling and optimizing UI performance — reducing overdraw, improving recomposition efficiency in Jetpack Compose, and hitting smooth 60/120fps rendering.
  • Hands-on work with performance tooling: Android Profiler, Perfetto, Baseline Profiles, or similar.
  • Published apps on Google Play you're proud of.
  • An active GitHub profile with code you're happy to share.
  • Hands-on experience with AI agents and LLM tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, etc.) — setting up agent environments, writing prompts, skills, and behavioral rules.
  • Experience with AI-powered IDE tools (Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, etc.) — including agent mode, rules files configuration, and integrating AI into the daily development workflow.
  • Understanding of model capabilities and limitations — knowing which model fits which task and how to manage the context window effectively.

  • Awareness of AI security risks — prompt injection, data leakage, and safe handling of untrusted inputs in agentic workflows.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.

We are looking to add a Senior Mechanical Engineer to our Mechanical Engineering team. If you enjoy working in a startup environment and are passionate about developing space hardware for leading-edge communications satellites, we would like to hear from you. 

In this position, you will be responsible for mechanical design aspects of Cesium phased array antennas, subsystems, and interfaces through all phases of the development process. The ideal candidate will be versatile and proficient in mechanical analysis, electronics packaging, computer-aided design (CAD), mechanical interfaces, thermal architecture, spacecraft propulsion, deployable and actuated structures, and environmental qualification of spacecraft antennas and payloads. You will be responsible for mechanical designs from concept through space flight including requirements definition, architecture trades and block diagrams, analysis, manufacturing, testing, qualification, and in-orbit support. 

The successful candidate will also present engineering design review materials to our customers and executive team, as well as participate in proposal-writing efforts. As such, excellent written and verbal communication skills are required. 


JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor of Science (BS) in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering from an accredited university or institution 
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in space antenna and payload mechanical engineering to include electronics packaging, thermal, shock, vibration, stress dynamics, and cost. A Master's degree may count as two years of experience. 
  • Experience in conducting architectural trade studies including parametric and first-order cost and physical analysis 
  • Experience with professional mechanical and FEA CAD tools, such as Ansys Mechanical, SolidWorks Simulation, and Thermal Desktop 
  • Experience with CNC manufacturing and GD&T 
  • Experience with advanced aerospace manufacturing and materials including sandwich panels and carbon composites, OR experience with high-reliability deployment mechanisms for space applications (including deployment, HDRMs, power delivery, etc.).
  • Proficiency in detailed mechanical design (3D CAD, drawings, etc.) 
  • Experience designing and manufacturing mechanisms and mechanical actuators 
  • Experience with EMI/EMC mitigation techniques 
  • Familiarity with satellite thermal architectures including heat pipes, phase change materials, contact resistance, and surface finishes as well as fundamental understandings of orbital thermal control in a LEO environment. 
  • Familiarity with launch and LEO environments (thermal, shock, vibe, radiation, etc) 
  • Familiarity with design for test, manufacturability, assembly, and reliability 
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills 

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE
  • Python, C++, or other programming languages 
  • Experience with large, deployable antenna arrays which drive your vision for the next generation of on-orbit communications and sensor arrays.
  • Robotics and control systems experience 
  • PCBA experience.
CesiumAstro considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills.

Please be aware that many roles will be subject to both security and export control restrictions. These restrictions mean that factors including new starter’s nationality, any previous or dual nationalities held, place of birth and country of residence may limit those roles that you can perform for the organization.

At Efficio, we're not just a consulting firm; we're a team of dedicated experts committed to transforming procurement and supply chain functions. Our mission is to drive sustainable, measurable value for our clients through innovative solutions and deep industry insights. Join us and be part of a dynamic environment where your skills and ideas make a real impact.

Efficio is the world’s largest specialist procurement and supply chain consultancy, with offices across Europe, North America, and the Middle East. We’re a diverse team of over 1,300 individuals, representing more than 60 nationalities and speaking 40+ languages – and we’re continuing to grow!

Efficio’s Recruitment team plays a key role in identifying and securing the talent that supports our global business, including an extensive network of independent consultants, freelancers and interim professionals who work alongside our permanent consulting teams.

We're looking for a Contractor Recruitment Specialist to join our global Talent Acquisition team, with a primary focus on sourcing and recruiting experienced independent consultants and interim professionals to support client engagements across our international business.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys proactive sourcing, building relationships with experienced professionals and working in a fast-paced environment where hiring requirements can change quickly.


What will you be doing?
  • Direct sourcing and recruitment: Identify, approach and engage high-quality independent consultants, freelancers and interim professionals across procurement, supply chain, transformation and related specialist disciplines.
  • Contractor recruitment delivery: Manage contractor recruitment requirements from initial briefing through to shortlisting, interviews, commercial discussions and engagement, working closely with internal stakeholders.
  • Stakeholder partnering: Work with project teams, Staffing and senior stakeholders to understand project requirements, advise on talent availability and identify suitable candidates within often demanding timescales.
  • Talent pipeline development: Build and maintain relationships with an international network of independent consultants, developing proactive talent pools aligned to current and anticipated project requirements.
  • Market intelligence: Provide insight into contractor availability, market conditions, day rates and relevant specialist talent pools to support hiring decisions.
  • Candidate relationship management: Develop long-term relationships with contractors, maintaining engagement between assignments and identifying opportunities for future collaboration.
  • Recruitment coordination: Support the wider contractor recruitment and engagement process, including rate negotiations, onboarding coordination, contract extensions and redeployment opportunities.

  • Continuous improvement: Work collaboratively with the wider Recruitment team to improve sourcing strategies, recruitment processes and the overall contractor experience.

About You

We're looking for someone who has:

  • 3–5 years' recruitment experience within contract, interim or freelance recruitment, either in an agency or in-house environment.
  • Strong direct sourcing capabilities, with a proven ability to identify, approach and engage experienced professionals who may not be actively looking for opportunities.
  • Experience recruiting professional, technical, consulting or specialist roles, ideally within management consulting, procurement, supply chain or professional services.
  • An understanding of the contract recruitment market, including contractor availability, day rates and the differences between permanent and interim recruitment.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to work directly with hiring managers, project teams and senior business stakeholders.
  • Strong communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage experienced independent professionals.
  • The ability to manage multiple requirements simultaneously, prioritise effectively and respond quickly to changing business needs.
  • A proactive, commercially aware and resourceful approach to recruitment, with a genuine interest in developing specialist talent networks.
  • Experience recruiting internationally would be advantageous, although not essential.

    •  

    Why Join Us?

    You'll join a collaborative global Recruitment team and play an important role in supporting the delivery of Efficio's client engagements around the world.

    You'll have the opportunity to work with experienced consulting professionals, develop an international network of specialist talent and take ownership of recruitment activity that directly supports our business.

Cluster Manager (Primair & Commercieel) en IT Manager (Technisch & functioneel)

Ondersteuning voor Single cluster (BnNe-regio)

Over ITS

Onze Business Unit Print & Copy Channel distribueert exclusief softwareoplossingen van toonaangevende leveranciers en ondersteunt een uitgebreid netwerk van meer dan 2.000 resellers en partners, verdeeld over zes regionale clusters.

Als het grootste PaperCut Authorised Solution Centre van Europa beschikken wij over een uitgebreid portfolio, waaronder PaperCut MF, NG, Hive en Pocket, evenals Umango, Willow360 en DocSlide. Daarnaast ontwikkelen wij diverse aanvullende modules die onze oplossingen verder versterken en uitbreiden.

Met vestigingen en activiteiten in het Verenigd Koninkrijk, Spanje, Nederland, België, Frankrijk, de DACH-regio en Oost-Europa zijn wij een werkelijk internationale organisatie. Tegelijkertijd behouden wij de persoonlijke betrokkenheid, korte lijnen en warme familiecultuur die ons al jarenlang kenmerken.

De Kans

Ben jij op zoek naar een uitdagende functie binnen een dynamische en snelgroeiende omgeving? Dan is dit jouw kans om je technische expertise verder te ontwikkelen en onderdeel te worden van het Technical Services Team van een internationaal en innovatief softwarebedrijf.

Voor deze functie zoeken wij een enthousiaste en nauwkeurige professional met een proactieve instelling en een sterk probleemoplossend vermogen. Je bent in staat om klanten hoogwaardige technische ondersteuning te bieden en hen te begeleiden bij de implementatie en het beheer van onze oplossingen voor print-, scan- en documentmanagement.

Je werkt hierbij onder andere met producten uit ons portfolio, waaronder PaperCut, Umango, DocSlide en diverse andere innovatieve softwareoplossingen.

Belangrijkste Verantwoordelijkheden

Customer Support (Klantenondersteuning)

1. Het bieden van technische ondersteuning via de helpdesk, telefonisch, e-mail en via remote sessies en incidenteel onsite bij partners en/of eindklanten.

2. Het installeren en configureren van softwareoplossingen zoals PaperCut MF en Hive, Umango en DocSlide.

3. Het analyseren en oplossen van technische vraagstukken.

Pre-Sales & Training

  2. Het ondersteunen van collega's en bijdragen aan interne IT-projecten.
  3. Het beantwoorden van technische vragen van klanten en partners.

  7. Technische en functionele interne Presales-vragen beantwoorden.
  8. Het creëren en uitvoeren van praktische technische trainingen en workshops voor partners.


Internal IT

1. Assisteren bij technische support aan collega's op zowel de software als de hardware die het bedrijf gebruikt.

2. Ondersteuning van de interne infrastructuur en diensten.

Vereiste kwalificaties

Ervaring & Achtergrond

  1. Uitstekende mondelinge en schriftelijke beheersing van het Nederlands en een goede beheersing van het Engels.
  2. Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om gemakkelijk een goede relatie op te bouwen met klanten.
  3. Ervaring met print management oplossingen, zoals "Papercut" of scanoplossingen, is meegenomen.


4. Ervaring met Microsoft Windows Server- en clientplatformen, Active Directory, Entra ID en Microsoft SQL Server.

5. Ervaring met Windows-printservers, printwachtrijen en het uitrollen van printerdrivers is een pré.

6. Gedegen kennis van netwerken (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, firewallpoorten en SNMP) voor het oplossen van communicatieproblemen tussen servers, clients en printers.

7. Sterke analytische en probleemoplossende vaardigheden, met een gestructureerde aanpak van complexe technische vraagstukken.

8. Een proactieve instelling en het vermogen om nieuwe technologieën snel en zelfstandig eigen te maken.

9. In staat om zowel zelfstandig als effectief binnen een team te werken.

  1. Kan zowel zelfstandig als in team werken.


Pré

  1. Eerdere ervaring in een functie op het gebied van klantenservice of technische ondersteuning.
  2. Kennis van PaperCut-functionaliteiten zoals Find-Me Printing, Print Deploy, Mobility Print en scanworkflows (scan-to-email, scan-to-folder en scan-to-cloud).
  3. Ervaring met het configureren van embedded software en kaartlezers op multifunctionele printers van merken zoals Canon, Ricoh, Konica Minolta, Kyocera of HP.
  4. Ervaring met andere print- en scanmanagementoplossingen, zoals Equitrac, uniFLOW of YSoft SAFEQ.
  5. Een PaperCut-certificering, bijvoorbeeld PaperCut Certified Engineer.
  6. Ervaring met virtualisatieplatformen en Microsoft Azure.
  7. Bekendheid met macOS en Linux.


Wat wij aanbieden

Wij geloven dat plezier in je werk net zo belangrijk is als goede arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Daarom bieden wij:

1. Een uitdagende functie binnen een internationale organisatie.

2. Veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid.

3. Hybride werken vanuit huis en/of ons kantoor in Almere.

4. Een auto van de zaak.

5. Laptop en telefoon van de zaak.

6. Een aantrekkelijk salaris passend bij jouw ervaring.

7. 25 vakantiedagen.

8. Uitgebreide opleidingen, trainingen en certificeringsmogelijkheden.

9. Een team van collega's dat elkaar ondersteunt en kennis deelt.

10. Ruimte om door te groeien richting consultancy, projectmanagement of specialistische technische rollen.

Bedrijfsbeschrijving

ITS Benelux maakt deel uit van de internationale ITS Group, een organisatie die al meer dan 35 jaar actief is en klanten ondersteunt in Europa, Noord-Amerika en daarbuiten.

Maar wat je vooral merkt als collega, is dat we ondanks onze internationale omvang een nuchtere en persoonlijke organisatie zijn gebleven.

We werken hard, helpen elkaar, vieren successen samen en geloven dat de beste ideeën ontstaan wanneer mensen zich prettig voelen op hun werk.

Hier ben je geen nummer, maar een belangrijk onderdeel van het team.

Voel je vrij om its-group.com en printandcopycontrol.com te bezoeken om meer te weten te komen over ons bedrijf en productportfolio.

iTS is gecertificeerd volgens de ISO 9001:2015- en ISO/IEC 27001:2022-normen.

Bedrijfswaarden

Klantgericht: We streven ernaar om te zorgen dat aan de behoeften van onze klanten worden voldaan en overtroffen, en bouwen sterke, langdurige relaties op.

Flexibel & Loyaal: We investeren tijd, energie en middelen in het koesteren van onze relaties, met als doel langdurig succes.

Internationaal team met een gezinsgeest: Onze bedrijfscultuur hecht waarde aan samenwerking, waardering en persoonlijke ontwikkeling, en biedt een waardevolle omgeving waar iedereen kan floreren.

ITS is niet:

Arrogant

Arrogantie laat mensen geloven dat ze altijd het beste weten. Het stopt het constante leren dat succes vereist. Wij zien arrogantie als het begin van het einde van elke organisatie.

Om te solliciteren

Denk je dat dit bij je past?

Mooi. Dan hoeven we niet per se een perfect CV te zien.

Ben jij technisch nieuwsgierig, klantgericht en heb je zin om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen een internationale organisatie? Dan gaan we graag met je in gesprek.

Graag ontvangen wij jouw cv, inclusief een motivatiebrief waarin je beschrijft:

1. Je praktische technische ervaring met PaperCut of andere producten binnen het ITS-portfolio, inclusief de omgevingen waarin je deze hebt geïmplementeerd, ondersteund of beheerd.

2. Voorbeelden van technische, presales- en adviesactiviteiten waaraan je hebt bijgedragen of die je hebt geleid, zoals solution design, productdemonstraties en aanbestedingstrajecten.

3. Je taalvaardigheden en, indien van toepassing, je kennis van de clusterregio en het bijbehorende partnernetwerk.

iTS is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt en zich inzet voor het opbouwen van een divers en inclusief team.
