jobs.title: Tender Manager
jobs.description:
Do you want to take ownership of how tenders are won, rather than simply contributing to them?

Valcon is looking for an experienced Bid Manager to take the lead across the entire bid and tender process. From identifying and qualifying opportunities to defining the strategy, coordinating decision-making, managing stakeholders, safeguarding quality and evaluating results. The primary focus will be on European public tenders.

This is explicitly not a traditional bid writing role. Rather than spending your days writing proposals yourself, you ensure that the right people deliver the strongest possible content at the right time. You create structure, challenge subject-matter experts, safeguard the strategy and quality, and keep stakeholders aligned throughout the process. But in case of emergency it is important for you to also be able to write a tender yourself, which occasionally will happen.

The principle is simple: don’t write it yourself – enable the team to write it better.

What will you do?

As Bid Manager, you will be responsible for the end-to-end management of bids and tenders. You will oversee the full tender pipeline and take the lead on complex bid processes involving multiple disciplines, seniority levels and stakeholder interests.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Centrally identifying, qualifying and prioritising relevant tenders and commercial opportunities;
  • Organising and facilitating Go/No-Go decisions and according to the required approval process;
  • Developing and safeguarding the bid strategy;
  • Translating it into a clear plan and structured tender process;
  • Independently leading multidisciplinary bid teams consisting of partners, managers, consultants, subject matter experts and in some cases external stakeholders;
  • Managing timelines, progress, compliance and quality throughout the entire bid process;
  • Organising reviews and critically assessing contributions before submission;
  • Safeguarding legal and procedural requirements, particularly for European public tenders;
  • Reporting on the tender pipeline, results and performance to the CRO;
  • Evaluating completed bids and systematically translating lessons learned into improvements;
  • Further developing governance, processes, tooling, knowledge management and reporting within the Tender Desk;
  • Using data, technology and AI to make the bid process smarter, more efficient and more effective;
  • Training and coaching colleagues who contribute to bids and helping to increase bid management maturity across the organisation;
  • In case of emergency, it is important to also be able to write tenders yourself.

As Bid Manager, you ensure that the overall process works: that the right people contribute, deadlines are met, decisions are made and strategy, quality and content come together.

You are a Bid Manager, not a Bid Writer

That distinction is important.

At Valcon, consultants, partners and subject-matter experts provide the content and contribute to the actual writing of bids. Some colleagues will be specifically trained to participate regularly in tender processes, while others may have limited experience with public tenders.

Your role is not to take over their writing. Instead, you ensure the team understands what is required, why it matters and when it needs to be delivered.

You are therefore a project manager, strategist, quality gatekeeper and challenger at the same time.

You are comfortable challenging an experienced consultant or partner when their contribution is not yet strong enough. You ask the right questions, keep the team focused on the agreed strategy and know how to create momentum without relying on formal authority.

Strong stakeholder management is therefore essential. You need to be able to lead complex projects and influence senior stakeholders, partners and consultants across the organisation.

Building the Tender Desk

In addition to managing individual bids, you will have another important responsibility: further professionalising Tender Management within Valcon.

A foundation is being created, but the way of working is still developing. This means you are not stepping into a fully established function where everything has already been defined.

Instead, you will have the opportunity to further shape the processes, standards, governance, tooling and knowledge-sharing structure behind successful tender management.

A modern approach to Bid Management is essential. Valcon aims to integrate data and AI into the bid process and is looking for someone who actively embraces these developments. You understand how technology can support opportunity identification, knowledge management, collaboration, quality and efficiency, and you are keen to explore how AI can become an integral part of the bid management process.

What do we offer you?

  • Personal development: a tailor-made growth path with training, courses, certification and mentoring by experienced colleagues.
  • An innovative work environment: collaborate with a team of experts pushing boundaries in data, technology, and consulting.
  • Inspiring work culture: a supportive, flexible, and no-nonsense environment that fosters your growth and fully allows you to be yourself.

Additionally, we offer:

  • Competitive employment benefits, including bonuses and expense allowance.
  • A company car or mobility budget.
  • A workplace that prioritizes and respects your work-life balance (for example by offering you the option of taking a sabbatical or expand the amount of holidays per year).
  • An affordable sports membership that allows you to participate in 50 different sports offered by over 10,000 partners.
  • The opportunity to work remotely from abroad for 10 days per year.
  • A vibrant community that organizes both professional and social events.

What do you bring to the table?

You are an experienced bid or tender management professional who is ready for a role in which strategy, leadership and coordination carry more weight than writing proposals yourself.

Ideally, you bring:

  • A demonstrable track record of contributing to successful bids and winning significant opportunities.
  • Significant experience in Bid Management and/or Tender Management within a complex professional environment;
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to create structure, organise decision-making and manage multiple workstreams and deadlines;
  • Strong senior stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence without formal authority;
  • The ability to assess tenders and commercial opportunities from a strategic and commercial perspective;
  • Experience within consulting, professional services or another knowledge-intensive environment is a strong advantage;
  • Affinity with data, AI and modern bid management tooling;
  • Experience coaching colleagues and helping teams adopt new ways of working;

Who are you?

You have the seniority and confidence to take the lead while still knowing how to bring people with you.

You can move comfortably between strategic discussions and operational delivery and thrive in an environment with senior professionals who each bring their own expertise, priorities and perspectives to a bid.

You are analytical and commercially minded, but also pragmatic. You ask challenging questions, make decisions when needed and are comfortable questioning whether the quality of a tender is genuinely good enough.

At the same time, you enjoy building and developing: teams, processes and a Bid Management capability that is still evolving.

Ready to apply?

Has the above sparked your interest and are you ready to join our innovative and impactful environment? And do our core values - Together, Joy, Curious, Can do, and Integrity - resonate with you?

Our recruitment team would be happy to hear from you! Please apply directly or get in touch with our recruitment team ----- to schedule a coffee meeting at our office first.

jobs.title: Physician Assistant of Verpleegkundig Specialist
jobs.description:
Wat ga je doen?

Bij Cardiologie Centra Nederland, locatie Dokkum draai je zelfstandig spreekuur en ben je medisch inhoudelijk verantwoordelijk voor je eigen patiëntenpopulatie. Je stelt zelfstandig diagnose- en behandelplannen op, verricht risicostratificatie en begeleidt patiënten met uiteenlopende, complexe cardiologische beelden, zoals:

  • Pijn op de borst (angina pectoris) en ischemische hartziekten;
  • Hartritmestoornissen (o.a. atriumfibrilleren);
  • Hartfalen, hypertensie en hypercholesterolemie;
  • Hartkleplijden.

Je combineert medisch-technische zorg met leefstijlgeneeskunde en langdurige opvolging. Waar nodig spar je op gelijkwaardige basis met de aanwezige cardiologen; de lijnen zijn bij ons kort en de sfeer is collegiaal. En omdat de inzet van een PA of VS bij onze locatie in Dokkum nieuw is, bieden we een kans: jij bouwt actief mee aan de vormgeving van deze rol en de polikliniek. Jouw visie, klinische blik en initiatief zijn hierin leidend.

De locatie in Dokkum is gevestigd binnen het Sionsberg Netwerk Ziekenhuis. Je komt te werken in een toegankelijk en informeel team, waarin we echt voor elkaar klaarstaan. Bovendien biedt het werken in Dokkum rust en ruimte: gratis parkeren voor de deur, geen files en een prachtige omgeving. Bij CCN denken we mee over jouw ontwikkeling. Mocht jij jouw werk bijvoorbeeld op de cardiologie willen afwisselen met ervaring binnen bijvoorbeeld de traumatologie. Dan is dit zeker bespreekbaar na de opstart van deze nieuwe rol binnen onze poli cardiologie.

Over ons: onze zorg klopt!

We zijn een organisatie van zelfstandige behandelcentra voor hart- en vaatziekten die zich onderscheidt door poliklinische zorg perfect af te stemmen op de behoeften van de patiënt en de verwijzer. We geloven in de kracht van complete zorg onder één dak. Onze patiënten kunnen dicht bij huis terecht voor de meest hoogwaardige cardiologische zorg, en jij speelt daarin een belangrijke rol.

We werken met geavanceerde hartritme-analyses (holtermonitoring), begeleiden patiënten op afstand via ons innovatieve e-health programma Hartwacht, en voeren poliklinisch elektrische cardioversies (ECV’s) uit. Met een eigen PM-technicus én een eigen spoedpolikliniek in huis is de dynamiek hoog.

Daarnaast beschikken we binnenkort over onze eigen CT coronairen. Met deze modernste apparatuur brengen we lokaal, snel en non-invasief de kransslagaders in beeld, een fantastische kwaliteitsimpuls voor jouw diagnostische werk.

Wie ben jij?

  • Je hebt de Master Physician Assistant (MPA) óf Master Advanced Nursing Practice (MANP) afgerond en beschikt over een geldige BIG-registratie;
  • Je hebt aantoonbare klinische ervaring binnen de cardiologie (of een zeer sterke affiniteit om je hier in te verdiepen);
  • Je bent communicatief sterk, werkt graag autonoom en zoekt de samenwerking op.

Wat bieden we jou?

Bij CCN krijg je een salaris conform CAO Zelfstandige Klinieken Nederland (ZKN), een fulltime dienstverband bestaat uit een 40-urige werkweek. De CAO zorgt voor een aantrekkelijk pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden. We willen het beste voor jou, het team en de patiënt. Wij bieden je onder andere het volgende:

  • Een salaris tussen €5.295,- tot €7.901,- conform FWG 65 (cao ZKN) o.b.v. 40 uur per week. We schalen je in op basis van jouw ervaring;
  • Vakantiegeld (8,33%), een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33% en deelname aan de pensioenregeling bij PFZW;
  • Een jaarcontract voor 16-32 uur per week, met duidelijke intentie op een volgend contract voor onbepaalde tijd;
  • Een gezonde werk-privébalans: wij bieden uitsluitend regelmaat. Je draait dus géén diensten in de weekenden of avond/nacht;
  • 160 uur vakantieverlof en 72 PLB-uren o.b.v. een fulltime dienstverband;
  • Reiskostenvergoeding van €0,23/km (er zijn parkeermogelijkheden bij deze locatie) of een NS business card voor woon-werkverkeer;
  • Vakinhoudelijke en professionele ontwikkeling met onze interne klinische lessen en andere opleidingsmogelijkheden. We denken hierbij graag met je mee wat bij jou past;
  • Extra secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals deelname aan onze fietsregeling, zodat je met belastingvoordeel een nieuwe fiets kan kopen. En voordeel op jouw ziektekostenverzekering met onze collectieve zorgverzekering bij IZZ of Zilveren Kruis Achmea.

jobs.title: Triage audicien - Beek, Limburg
jobs.description:
Bouw mee aan hoogwaardige hoorzorg binnen een zelfstandige optiekwinkel

Ben jij audicien en wil je méér dan alleen hoortoestellen aanpassen? Zoek je een plek waar je de tijd krijgt voor je klant, kwaliteit vooropstaat en je tegelijkertijd de ruimte krijgt om mee te bouwen aan een succesvolle audiotak?

Dan is dit misschien wel jouw volgende stap.

Premium hoorzorg, zoals het bedoeld is

Binnen onze zelfstandige optiekwinkels staat persoonlijke aandacht centraal. Onze klanten kennen ons vanwege onze deskundigheid, kwaliteit en service. Diezelfde benadering willen we verder uitbouwen binnen horen.

Daarom zoeken we een audicien die samen met ons wil bouwen aan een sterke audiotak. Afhankelijk van de situatie gaat het om het verder ontwikkelen van een bestaande klantenkring of het opbouwen van een nieuwe activiteit binnen een winkel waar al een vertrouwde klantenbasis aanwezig is.

Je krijgt daarbij de ruimte om je vak uit te oefenen zoals jij vindt dat goede hoorzorg hoort te zijn: met tijd voor de klant, persoonlijke aandacht en premium hooroplossingen.

Wat maakt deze functie anders?

Je werkt in een professionele, persoonlijke omgeving waar niet de snelle verkoop, maar de beste oplossing voor de klant centraal staat.

Je kunt rekenen op:

· Premium hooroplossingen

· Ruim voldoende tijd en aandacht voor iedere klant

· Een bestaand klantenbestand vanuit de optiek

· Warme leads via onze partner Audibene

· Professionele ondersteuning en coaching vanuit de organisatie

· Ruimte voor jouw ideeën en vakmanschap

· De kans om daadwerkelijk mee te bouwen aan de audiotak

· Dagen en uren in overleg, met aandacht voor een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé

Voor wie is dit een mooie stap?

Misschien werk je nu bij een grotere keten en zoek je meer persoonlijke aandacht, vrijheid en betrokkenheid. Of je bent toe aan een omgeving waarin je niet alleen audicien bent, maar ook kunt meedenken over hoe we de beste hoorzorg voor onze klanten organiseren.

Ruime ervaring is voor ons niet het belangrijkste. Veel belangrijker is dat je passie hebt voor horen én voor mensen.

Je bent iemand die kwaliteit belangrijk vindt, graag persoonlijk contact heeft met klanten en energie krijgt van samen iets moois opbouwen. Je wilt onderdeel zijn van een professioneel en kundig team, maar vindt het tegelijkertijd leuk om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen voor je eigen vakgebied.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Een zelfstandige functie met veel ruimte voor vakmanschap en persoonlijke aandacht, maar mét een professioneel team en organisatie achter je.

Geen omgeving waarin iedere minuut wordt gestuurd door targets en agenda’s, maar een plek waar we geloven dat tevreden klanten en goede hoorzorg de basis zijn voor duurzaam succes.

En minstens zo belangrijk: werk moet passen bij je leven. Daarom bespreken we graag samen welke dagen en uren het beste aansluiten. Of je nu een aantal dagen per week wilt werken of juist een volgende stap zoekt met meer verantwoordelijkheid: we kijken vooral naar wat bij elkaar past.

Zin om samen iets moois op te bouwen?

Ben jij audicien en spreekt de combinatie van kwaliteit, persoonlijke aandacht, vrijheid en bouwen je aan?

Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Ook als je nog niet jarenlang ervaring hebt, maar wel gepassioneerd bent over het vak, nodigen we je van harte uit om te reageren.

jobs.description:
Als je goed zorgt voor je mensen, zorgen zij goed voor jou. Deze overtuiging van de oprichter van ADG Dienstengroep vormt de basis van Koersmakers. Koersmakers is een nieuw bedrijf dat werkt aan duurzame inzetbaarheid voor vakmensen, zodat zij maximale regie krijgen over het (werkende) leven. Om dit goed in de praktijk te brengen zijn we op zoek naar een adviseur in de regio Zuid Nederland

Omschrijving van het team

Koersmakers is een jong, maar groeiend team van 9 collega’s. De mobiliteitsadviseurs Annemiek, Celine, Wilco, Miranda, Mariëlle, Dana en Inez, begeleiden ieder in hun eigen regio vakmensen in verschillende trajecten: van spoor 2 re-integratie tot (loopbaan)coaching en van gespreksbegeleiding tot leiderschapstrainingen. Zwaantje ondersteunt hen in de dagelijkse operatie en Sterre is kwartiermaker en eindverantwoordelijk voor Koersmakers.

Taken

Wat ga je doen?

Als adviseur ga jij in de verschillende trajecten de verhalen, doelen en talenten van hun vakmensen naar boven halen. Op dit moment begeleid je hoofdzakelijk medewerkers in een Spoor 2 re-integratie traject. Tegelijkertijd worden we inmiddels ook steeds vaker gevraagd om vakmensen te begeleiden in (loopbaan)-coaching trajecten en bij gespreksbegeleiding. En die beweging naar preventieve dienstverlening omtrent de inzetbaarheid van vakmensen is precies de stap die ze de komende tijd samen met jou willen zetten.

In de begeleiding van vakmensen maak je gebruik van passende (interesse)testen, waaronder de Predictive Index. Jij zet vervolgens dat wat iemand wil, drijft en kan, om naar concrete acties om de inzetbaarheid van deze vakmensen te vergroten en behouden. Hierbij houd je rekening met de actuele regels tot Wet Verbetering Poortwachter en de verzuimcyclus van het UWV. Daarnaast ondersteun je de leidinggevenden van de verschillende ADG bedrijven hoe zij samen met hen de regie van vakmensen op het (werkende) leven naar de praktijk kunnen brengen.

Ze vinden het geen probleem als je geen tot weinig ervaring hebt met het gebruik van onze testen.

Vereisten

Wat ze wel belangrijk vinden:

  • Je hebt ervaring met het uitvoeren van Spoor 2 re-integratie trajecten.
  • Je vindt het leuk om te werken aan de duurzame inzetbaarheid van hun medewerkers. Vakmensen die werk doen wat vaak niet gezien wordt, juist als het écht goed gedaan wordt. Schoonmaakmedewerkers, onderhoudsmonteurs, hospitality professionals, BOA’s en zorgmedewerkers. Zij houden Nederland draaiend. Zij doen het voor hén.
  • Jij zorgt dat de uitvoering van hun dienstverlening (in geval van Spoor 2 re-integratie) voldoet aan de eisen die de verzuimcyclus en de Wet Verbetering Poortwachter stelt.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig, beschikt over probleemoplossend vermogen en neemt regie over de trajecten die je begeleidt. Je schakelt gemakkelijk met verschillende gesprekspartners en vertaalt doelen naar concrete stappen, ook wanneer de situatie nog niet volledig duidelijk is
  • Je werkt gericht toe naar (nieuwe) mogelijkheden voor vakmensen om (weer) inzetbaar te worden en blijven. Je vertaalt doelen en mogelijkheden in concrete afspraken en houdt jezelf, medewerkers en leidinggevenden aan deze afspraken.
  • Jij blijft je, ook bij weerstand of uitdagingen, inspannen om de inzetbaarheid van vakmensen te vergroten of behouden.
  • Je werkt precies en zorgvuldig en signaleert bij onvolledigheden en afwijkingen in de begeleiding of rapportages. Hierbij schroom je niet om te benoemen wat je ziet en hoort, durf je kritische vragen te stellen, altijd met het doel om tot oplossingen en mogelijkheden voor inzetbaarheid te komen en altijd met respect voor de ander.

Benefits

Dit mag jeverwachten

o De predictive index practitioner

o Of een andere opleiding die bijdraagt aan de doelstelling van Koersmakers: regie over het (werkende) leven naar de praktijk brengen.

  • Een fijne werkplek in Houten of bij een van onze ADG zusjes.
  • Mogelijkheid om thuis te werken.
  • De kans om echt impact te maken en mee te bouwen aan een nieuw bedrijf

Over Koersmakers

Koersmakers is een startup van ADG. Een Twents familiebedrijf met ruim 11.000 collega’s dat groot is geworden met en dankzij hun vakmensen op de werkvloer. ADG zet zich in voor vakmensen met waardering en ondersteuning.

Bij Koersmakers geloven ze in gelijke kansen voor iedereen en in een open organisatie waar iedereen zich prettig voelt. Zij willen dan ook een diverse en inclusieve werkgever zijn. Inclusie zorgt ervoor dat werknemers, ongeacht hun achtergrond, overtuigingen, voorkeuren etc, zich gewaardeerd, gerespecteerd en betrokken voelen. Koersmakers gelooft dat dit leidt tot een creatievere en productievere werksfeer, waar innovatieve ideeën kunnen bloeien, betere besluiten worden genomen en talenten volledig tot hun recht kunnen komen.

The Netherlands is where we started and it is still the market we know best. We are looking for a Marketing & Content Intern to work on all of it with us.

The briefs, templates and guidelines already exist, so you are never starting from a blank page. You will use them from week one and take on more of the work yourself as you go. Most of what you do will be in Dutch.

  • Watch what our restaurant partners post, respond where it makes sense, and flag anything the marketing team should see.

Je werkt nauw samen met klanten, leveranciers, onderaannemers en interne stakeholders en hebt de volledige verantwoordelijkheid voor projecten met een waarde van circa €25.000 tot €1 miljoen.

Als Project Manager ben jij de drijvende kracht achter het volledige projectproces, van initiatief en voorbereiding tot uitvoering en oplevering.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor:

  • Het leiden van bouwkundige, technische en facilitaire projecten van aanvraag tot oplevering
  • Het opstellen en bewaken van projectplannen, budgetten, planningen en risicoanalyses
  • Het vertalen van klantwensen naar concrete projectdoelstellingen en programma's van eisen
  • Het aansturen en coördineren van interne teams, leveranciers en onderaannemers
  • Het bewaken van kwaliteit, veiligheid, contractuele verplichtingen en commerciële doelstellingen
  • Het fungeren als belangrijkste aanspreekpunt voor klanten en stakeholders
  • Het beheren van de dagelijkse operationele aspecten van projecten, inclusief toezicht op locatie
  • Het zorgen voor volledige naleving van CBRE-processen, projectmanagementrichtlijnen en QHSE-standaarden
  • Het voorbereiden en presenteren van projectrapportages aan klanten en interne stakeholders
  • Het signaleren van nieuwe projectkansen en het opbouwen van sterke klantrelaties

Geen dag is hetzelfde. De ene dag leid je een bouwvergadering op locatie, de volgende dag presenteer je een projectupdate aan een stuurgroep of bespreek je innovatieve oplossingen met een klant.

Vereisten

WAT BRENG JE MEE?

Wij zoeken een ervaren professional die techniek, organisatie en stakeholdermanagement succesvol weet te combineren.

  • Hbo-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in Bouwkunde, Elektrotechniek, Installatietechniek, Infratechniek of een vergelijkbare richting
  • Minimaal 3 tot 5 jaar ervaring met technische of bouwkundige projecten
  • Ervaring binnen de technische dienstverlening, bouw, vastgoed of facility management is een pré
  • Sterke organisatorische, commerciële en communicatieve vaardigheden
  • Ervaring met budgetbeheer, planning en contractmanagement
  • Leiderschapskwaliteiten en het vermogen om meerdere stakeholders effectief te managen
  • Een proactieve, resultaatgerichte en klantgerichte instelling
  • VCA-VOL of de bereidheid deze te behalen
  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal
  • Bereidheid om te reizen naar projectlocaties binnen Nederland

jobs.title: Account Executive (m/w/d) Legal Tech – DACH
jobs.description:
Where Legal Leads. 

Drei Worte. Eine Überzeugung. Rechtsabteilungen sind nicht länger die Bremse im Unternehmen – sie sind der Hebel. Bei DiliTrust geben wir ihnen die Plattform, die diesem Anspruch gerecht wird: Verträge, Beteiligungen, Vorstandsarbeit und Legal AI – eine integrierte Suite für die gesamte Rechtsfunktion. Im Einsatz bei mehr als 3.000 Unternehmen in 64 Ländern, darunter führende Konzerne in Europa, Nordamerika und MEA. 

DACH ist unser nächster großer Wachstumsmarkt. Die Basis steht, jetzt skalieren wir. Du übernimmst ein eigenes Territory, baust deine Strategie eigenständig auf und entscheidest, wo du wachsen willst – unterstützt von einem Team aus Solution Consultants, BDR, Marketing und Customer Success, das in DACH bereits liefert. 

Der Legal-Tech-Markt ist über 16 Milliarden Dollar schwer und wächst jedes Jahr zweistellig. In zwei Jahren wirst du auf diesen Moment zurückblicken. 

Die Frage ist nur: Warst du dabei? 


Deine Rolle 
 

Du verantwortest ein eigenes Vertical in DACH, z.B. Financial Services, Energy, Manufacturing oder Pharma. Dein Fokus liegt auf Neukundengewinnung und gezieltem Cross-Sell in deinem bestehenden Portfolio. 

  • Du identifizierst und qualifizierst neue Opportunities, gemeinsam mit deinem BDR, über Anfragen, Marketing und gezielte Ansprache. 

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, nicht aus dem Bauch. Du baust deinen Territory Plan auf, entwickelst Account Plans für deine Top-Targets und treibst gemeinsam mit deinem BDR fokussierte Pod Sprints in deinem Vertical. 

  • Deine Deals liegen typischerweise zwischen 50.000 € und 200.000 € Jahresvolumen. Sales-Cycles dauern 4–9 Monate. Pro Deal sprichst du mit 4–7 Entscheidern: Legal, IT, Einkauf, Finance, manchmal Vorstand. 

  • Du verkaufst eine Plattform, kein Einzelprodukt. Erstgespräche führen oft Legal Ops Manager oder General Counsel. Deals über mehrere Module sind bei uns die Regel. 

  • Du repräsentierst DiliTrust auf den wichtigen Branchen-Events wie z.B. Legal Revolution oder LegalTech. Du führst dort die Gespräche, die später zu Pipeline werden. 


Must-have

  • 4+ Jahre Erfahrung im quotaverantwortlichen B2B-Software-Vertrieb, idealerweise im SaaS-Umfeld. 

  • Erfahrung in komplexen Sales-Cycles mit mehreren Entscheidern aus Legal, IT, Finance oder Procurement. 

  • Methodisches Arbeiten: Du qualifizierst sauber (z. B. mit MEDDPICC) und führst belastbare Forecasts. 

  • Erfahrung im Verkauf an C-Level-Entscheider. 

  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachen-Niveau, sehr gutes Englisch – unsere Unternehmenssprache ist Englisch. 


Nice-to-have

  • Erfahrung im Verkauf an Rechts-, Governance- oder Compliance-Funktionen. 

  • Du kennst die Welt regulierter Branchen - Financial Services, Energy, Healthcare oder Pharma. 

  • Du hast bereits eigenständig ein Territory aufgebaut – mit klarer Account-Strategie und nachhaltigem Pipeline-Aufbau. 

  • Du interessierst dich für KI im Unternehmenskontext  und kannst Kunden den Unterschied zwischen Hype und echtem Mehrwert erklären. 


Was wir dir bieten

  • Remote-First. Du arbeitest von zuhause oder in unseren Offices in München und Berlin - regelmäßige Team-Events bringen uns offline zusammen. 

  • Onboarding und Ramp-Up, das zu einem komplexen Produkt passt. Produkt, Branche und Methodik step by step - mit erfahrenen Teamkollegen, die dich auf Tempo bringen. 

  • Ehrliches Coaching, präsenter Sales Manager. Wir sind 7 Leute im DACH-Sales, keine Nummer in einer großen Maschine. Regelmäßige Einzelgespräche, gemeinsame Deal-Reviews. Wenn du gut bist, wird das gesehen. Wenn etwas hakt, wird darüber gesprochen. 

  • Karriereperspektive in einer Wachstumsregion. Senior AE, Enterprise AE, Team Lead DACH: wir bauen die Region aktiv aus, nicht ab. 

  • Internationales Setup, lokaler Fokus. Dein Spielfeld ist DACH, aber wenn dich die Lust auf Mailand, Madrid oder Mexico City packt, kannst du auch von dort arbeiten. 

  • 30 Tage Urlaub, Zulage für Heimarbeit und weitere Vorteile folgen in Kürze! 


Dein Weg zu uns

  1. Erstgespräch mit dem Recruiting-Team (30 Min, auf Englisch) – wir lernen uns kennen, klären gegenseitige Erwartungen. 

  1. Interview mit dem Sales Manager DACH (45 Min) – Deep Dive in deine Erfahrung, deine Methodik und Fit für die Rolle. 

  1. Interview mit dem Global Chief Sales Officer (45 Min) – Strategie, Karriereperspektive, Final-Check. 

  1. Kurzes Rollenspiel (45 Min) – eine realistische Sales-Situation, an der wir sehen, wie du arbeitest. Du bekommst Briefing und Vorbereitungszeit. 

Bist du bereit, bei uns einzusteigen?

Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf – wenn möglich auf Englisch – ein Anschreiben ist nicht erforderlich. Wenn du vorab Fragen hast: ----- oder sende eine LinkedIn-Nachricht an Fabian Pohl.

Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von allen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, Religion, sexueller Identität oder Behinderung.

Hinweis: Wir nutzen KI-gestützte Tools zur Vorauswahl von Bewerbungen. Die endgültige Entscheidung trifft immer ein Mensch.

jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI/ML Engineer based in Germany.

Join a mission-driven engineering team developing practical AI systems that address real-world challenges in healthcare, agriculture, education, and international development. As an AI/ML Engineer, you will design, build, evaluate, deploy, and continuously improve AI-powered applications used by nonprofit organizations and their communities. You will work on solutions ranging from clinical copilots and AI coaching tools to agricultural advisory chatbots and evaluation infrastructure. Collaborating with behavioral scientists, researchers, and embedded engineers, you will translate applied AI research into reliable, scalable products and reusable technical resources. You will also help partner organizations strengthen their own AI capabilities through mentorship, open-source contributions, and knowledge sharing. This fully remote role offers substantial technical ownership and the opportunity to apply advanced AI engineering to initiatives that can improve outcomes for millions of people.


Accountabilities:

In this role, you will build and improve production-ready AI systems while helping nonprofit partners adopt effective, measurable, and responsible AI practices. Your work will combine hands-on engineering, applied research, experimentation, and collaboration with teams working directly in the field.

  • Design, build, evaluate, deploy, and improve machine learning systems and AI-powered applications for real-world use cases.

  • Contribute to open-source AI evaluation infrastructure and tools that help nonprofit organizations assess and improve their AI products.

  • Work closely with behavioral scientists, researchers, and field teams to identify recurring challenges and translate findings into reusable tools, frameworks, playbooks, and technical publications.

  • Develop rigorous evaluation methods for AI systems, including appropriate datasets, evaluation criteria, and measurable performance improvements.

  • Build and iterate on production-grade LLM applications and agentic systems, improving their reliability, usefulness, and performance for intended users.

  • Release meaningful technical innovations from partner projects as open-source contributions whenever appropriate.

  • Deliver solutions through rapid development and deployment cycles, using experimentation and measurable feedback to guide improvements.

  • Document technical decisions, maintain engineering standards, and ensure AI components remain reliable and maintainable.

  • Monitor developments in applied AI research, assess relevant advances, and test promising approaches in practical settings.

  • Advise and support nonprofit organizations developing generative AI products, helping them adopt effective engineering practices, tools, and workflows.

  • Mentor partner organization staff and help strengthen their internal technical capabilities and responsible AI practices.

  • Contribute to workshops, seminars, and knowledge-sharing initiatives that communicate lessons and best practices from ongoing projects.

  • Conduct site visits to understand operational challenges, observe how AI tools are used, and recommend technical improvements based on direct user needs.

  • Take initiative in identifying problems, defining solutions, and driving projects through implementation and deployment.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate combines strong machine learning fundamentals with substantial hands-on experience delivering end-user AI products. You should be comfortable moving between research, experimentation, production engineering, and collaboration with nontechnical stakeholders, while maintaining a strong focus on practical impact.

    • Strong foundations in mathematics, deep learning, large language models (LLMs), and modern AI systems.

    • At least 4 years of hands-on machine learning engineering experience, including building, evaluating, and systematically improving at least one end-user-facing product powered by deep learning. Experience limited to integrating model APIs, building internal dashboards, or contributing solely to ML infrastructure does not meet this requirement.

    • At least 1–2 years of experience building LLM-powered applications, including at least one production-grade agent beyond a proof of concept.

    • Practical experience evaluating AI systems, with a strong understanding of dataset design, evaluation methodology, and performance measurement.

    • Proficiency in Python and a willingness to remain deeply involved in hands-on implementation.

    • Fluency in prompting and context engineering for agentic systems, including the ability to determine whether a problem requires improved prompting, a different model, better tools, or changes to the overall pipeline.

    • Experience using AI coding agents to produce high-quality work, with the judgment and accountability to validate outputs and take responsibility for what you ship.

    • Ability to read research papers, assess new ideas, and quickly test relevant approaches through practical experimentation.

    • An experimental mindset, with the ability to reason carefully about data, models, and evaluation while making iterative, measurable progress.

    • Strong first-principles thinking and the ability to design practical, scalable solutions.

    • A user-focused approach that prioritizes whether a product works effectively for its intended audience.

    • Proactive ownership, urgency, attention to detail, and the ability to carry projects through to completion without constant direction.

    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to nonengineering audiences.

    • A commitment to responsible AI development and technology that delivers meaningful social benefits.

      • Bonus qualifications:

      • Experience with multilingual natural language processing or low-resource languages, particularly Swahili, Hindi, and languages spoken across East Africa and South Asia.

      • Previous work in global health, international development, or social-impact technology.

      • Familiarity with behavioral science or AI applications designed to support behavior change.

      • Experience with data annotation pipelines and LLM evaluation methodologies.

      • Knowledge of AI safety, alignment, or responsible AI frameworks.

      • Experience deploying models in production and working with cloud infrastructure such as AWS, Google Cloud Platform, or Azure.

      • Publications at leading AI conferences or substantial technical writing documenting engineering research and results.

        • Benefits:

        • Compensation: Competitive within the mission-driven technology sector, with compensation positioned below typical big-tech salary levels.

        • Remote work: Fully remote, asynchronous-first working environment.

        • Flexible schedule: Work hours can accommodate your time zone, with no mandated core hours.

        • International collaboration: Join a globally distributed team working across North America, Europe, East Africa, East Asia, and South Asia.

        • Meaningful impact: Build AI applications addressing practical challenges in healthcare, agriculture, and other areas of international development.

        • Technical ownership: Take projects from initial problem definition and model selection through deployment, evaluation, and continuous improvement.

        • Interdisciplinary collaboration: Work alongside behavioral scientists, development economists, field researchers, and embedded engineers.

        • Open-source contributions: Share technical innovations, tools, and learnings with the wider community rather than keeping all work within proprietary products.

        • Professional development: Stay close to applied AI research and gain experience solving challenging problems in real operational environments.

        • Autonomy and responsibility: Contribute within a small team with minimal hierarchy, direct feedback, and opportunities to influence technical decisions.

jobs.title: Accountant
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Accountant based in Switzerland.

As an Accountant, you will play a key role in maintaining accurate financial records and supporting accounting operations across an international group of regulated entities. You will take ownership of the Accounts Payable function while contributing to the full accounting cycle, including month-end closing, reconciliations, intercompany transactions, tax compliance, and audit preparation. Working within a lean, international finance team, you will collaborate with external accounting firms and tax advisors across multiple jurisdictions. You will help strengthen financial controls, improve reporting accuracy, and streamline accounting processes in a dynamic digital asset environment. This position offers broad responsibilities, hands-on involvement, and the opportunity to contribute ideas that improve how the finance function operates. It is an excellent opportunity for a detail-oriented accounting professional who enjoys autonomy, technical challenges, and working at the intersection of traditional finance and cryptocurrency.


Accountabilities
  • Accounts Payable management: Own the end-to-end supplier payment process, including invoice review, coding, approval workflows through tools such as ApprovalMax and Xero, payment preparation, supplier statement reconciliations, and vendor master data maintenance.
  • General ledger accounting: Prepare and manage journal entries, accruals, prepayments, and other accounting adjustments to ensure accurate financial records.
  • Financial closing: Coordinate monthly, quarterly, and annual closing activities across group entities, working closely with external accounting firms to ensure timely and accurate reporting.
  • Reconciliations and account analysis: Perform balance sheet and bank reconciliations, investigate discrepancies, and ensure account balances are accurate, complete, and properly supported.
  • Intercompany accounting: Manage monthly intercompany reconciliations, recharges, and settlements across multiple entities, ensuring consistency and resolving outstanding differences.
  • Tax and VAT compliance: Support VAT reporting and other tax compliance activities across jurisdictions, including VAT returns, reverse-charge transactions, and withholding taxes, in collaboration with external tax advisors.
  • Audit preparation: Prepare supporting documentation and audit files, coordinate information requests, and assist with interim and annual external audits.
  • Internal controls and process improvement: Identify opportunities to strengthen financial controls, improve accounting workflows, and increase the efficiency and reliability of financial operations.
  • Cross-functional accounting support: Contribute across the full accounting cycle, balancing routine processing with complex technical accounting tasks while maintaining high standards of accuracy and consistency.
  • International collaboration: Work effectively with external service providers and colleagues across jurisdictions to ensure accounting practices remain aligned with applicable requirements and reporting deadlines.

    • Requirements

  • A degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline.
  • Approximately 5 years of accounting experience, ideally with an initial background in Big Four audit or accounting outsourcing.
  • Strong technical accounting knowledge, including general ledger accounting, financial closing, reconciliations, accruals, prepayments, and the full accounting cycle.
  • Experience working with multi-entity organizations, intercompany accounting, and preferably group consolidation.
  • Hands-on Accounts Payable experience, including invoice processing, payment preparation, supplier reconciliations, and approval workflows.
  • Working knowledge of VAT and corporate tax compliance, with international or cross-border VAT experience considered an advantage.
  • Experience preparing for and supporting external audits, including compiling documentation and responding to auditor requests.
  • Proficiency with accounting software and strong Excel skills; familiarity with Xero and ApprovalMax is an advantage.

jobs.title: Senior Reinforcement Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity 

We are looking for a Senior Reinforcement Learning Engineer to join our Motion Intelligence team. You should bring deep expertise in reinforcement learning and policy optimisation, grounded in real-world robotics experience, and be excited to push the boundaries of autonomous robots. We are looking for someone who can provide senior-level RL and learning-based control guidance across the team — shaping how we train, deploy, and maintain learned policies on physical robots operating in demanding industrial environments.
Beyond RL expertise, we value engineers who take pride in writing clean, maintainable code, simplifying complex systems through thoughtful design, and championing sound interfaces and architecture.

At ANYbotics, we develop tailored software solutions that enable our legged robots to execute inspection and maintenance tasks with precision and consistency. This role sits at the intersection of cutting-edge RL research and production robotics — from sim-to-real policy transfer and reward engineering through to reliable deployment on mission-critical systems in the field. You’ll work across the full lifecycle — from early development prototyping through to mission‑critical, production deployments.

 
The Market & Our Technology 

ANYbotics transforms industrial plants in the energy, process, and utility sector by introducing robotics to a wide range of novel applications that so far were beyond reach. Our customers are large asset operators and industrial service providers pioneering the use of robotics technology for inspection and maintenance. Our mobile robot ANYmal uses legs for extreme mobility in complex environments, camera- and LIDAR-based sensing for full autonomy and obstacle avoidance, and AI for high-quality and consistent inspection results. We develop numerous customised hardware systems, including the entire robotic platform, actuators, sensors, inspection payloads, charging systems, and all related ANYbotics electrical hardware.

jobs.title: Publishing Product Director
jobs.description:
As Publishing Product Director, you are the creative custodian of one of Crytek’s games, embedded inside the game team, accountable for protecting the creative vision and translating the promise of the game into work that the publishing team can execute with conviction. The success of a great game depends on the work that surrounds it landing as truthfully as the game itself, and closing that gap is what this role exists to do. You make sure that what reaches players is authentic, aspirational, tells the story the game deserves, and delights the players who play it. 

The game in your remit is an unannounced project in the Crytek portfolio. The work focuses on shaping the project’s player promise from the inside out, defining the publishing narrative for its eventual reveal, and carrying its creative vision through to launch and into ongoing releases. 

You sit inside the game team, working shoulder-to-shoulder with game leadership every day. You partner directly with the Chief Publishing Officer and Brand & Marketing Director to support both the game and the business as one connected effort. You are the direct line between the game team and the publishing organization, the person who protects the north star on both ends, and the person both sides trust to tell them the truth. 

This role demands creative conviction, drive, and the kind of experience that only comes from working shoulder-to-shoulder with game teams. You will protect the team from noise so they can build the game, and you will give the publishing team the clarity, player insight, and creative truth they need to land it well. It is one of the most consequential seats at Crytek, and one of the most rewarding. 


What You'll Do
  • Be the custodian of the game’s creative vision, tone, and player promise, and translate it into work that publishing can execute with conviction
  • Sit embedded inside the game team and act as the daily bridge between game leadership and the publishing organisation  
  • Serve as the source of truth on what the game is, what is coming next, and what it means for players, across Marketing, Comms, Community, and Commercial  
  • Brief and review every major marketing, comms, and community output for creative authenticity, ensuring it tells the right player story  
  • Partner with the Chief Publishing Officer and Brand & Marketing Director to shape go-to-market plans that serve the game and the business in equal measure  
  • Drive franchise narrative, player promise, and creative direction across reveals, beats, and post-launch moments  
  • Protect the game team from operational noise so they can focus on building, while translating publishing priorities into work the team can act on  
  • Keep the north star intact on both ends, keeping publishing grounded in the game’s vision, and the game team grounded in player and market reality  

    • What You Bring
  • 8+ years working at the seam between game development and publishing or marketing, with significant time embedded inside game teams
  • Proven ability to translate creative vision into commercial activation without compromising either side, with strong creative judgement and editorial instinct you can defend under pressure  
  • Fluency across business models (premium, live service, DLC, F2P) and multi-year roadmap strategy, and how the two shape the player promise  
  • Cross-functional leadership and the ability to influence without authority across game and publishing teams  
  • Strong player insight, audience segmentation, and community fluency  
  • Drive and operating range, comfortable moving from creative critique in the morning to commercial trade-offs in the afternoon  
  • Experience supporting or launching at least one major game or live-service title from inside the game team  
  • Track record of being trusted by both game leadership and publishing leadership  

    • What you can expect from us

    A healthy body is a healthy mind. We offer a membership at the premium gym chain Fitness First in Germany. Work out, join group fitness classes, or relax in the wellness facilities.

    We’ve recently moved into a brand-new, modern office located in the heart of Frankfurt. Our new workspace is designed to inspire creativity and collaboration, with open areas, quiet zones, and top-tier facilities — all just steps away from public transport, restaurants, bars and cultural hotspots.

    We believe in the value of in-person collaboration while also supporting flexibility. Our hybrid working model includes three days per week in the office and the option to work remotely up to two days per week, unless role-specific requirements or business needs require you to be on site.

    We’re building a workplace where everyone belongs. We welcome people of all backgrounds and identities and are proud to be a truly global team, with employees from over 42 countries contributing their ideas, cultures, and perspectives every day.

jobs.description:
Staff Backend Engineer – Platform 

Join Apaleo and shape the future of hospitality tech 

Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure lets hoteliers customise their tech stack, automate routine work and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay. 

If you're driven by the idea of making hospitality smarter, more human and powered by cutting-edge technology, we'd love to hear from you. 

 

About the role 

You'll join our Platform team as an individual contributor working closely with our Principal Engineer, who leads Platform's technical direction. Platform owns infrastructure, developer experience and security foundations for the whole engineering org, so this is a high-ownership seat: you'll take on large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives and drive them from first analysis through to completion, with real autonomy over how you get there. 

We don't run a groomed backlog or sprint planning. We assign a big topic to someone who owns it end to end. If you thrive with structure handed to you, this isn't the role; if you love spotting the problem worth solving and driving it yourself, you'll fit right in. 

 

What you'll be up to 

  • Architecting and developing scalable, reliable and maintainable backend systems. 
  • Self-identifying and scoping problems and initiatives, not just executing assigned tickets: assessing impact, prioritisation and timing independently. 
  • Leading architectural decisions and design discussions with cross-team alignment. 
  • Driving large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives end to end, including coordination with multiple stakeholders. 
  • Mentoring engineers and driving technical excellence. 
  • Building and maintaining internal tools and infrastructure (AWS, Terraform) that empower teams to deliver faster and more reliably. 
  • Owning observability, logging and operational excellence to keep the platform highly available. 
  • Participating in on-call rotations and stepping in as a reliable problem solver during incidents. 
  • Proactively spotting where AI and automation can drive technical improvement. 

 

Some of the challenges waiting for you 

  • Solving horizontal write-scaling for our database (we already scale reads horizontally). 
  • Modernising our CI/CD pipeline for faster, more reliable delivery. 
  • Migrating our infrastructure-as-code fully from CloudFormation to Terraform, including the ability to recreate an Apaleo environment from scratch. 
  • Extracting and reworking common services (like shared schedulers) to get us ready for our next scale level. 

 

What you'll bring to the team 

  • 8+ years of backend development experience, including several years in a staff-level or technical leadership role. 
  • Strong engineering fundamentals that transfer across languages and cloud platforms: we care more about how you think than which stack you've used. 
  • A track record of owning large technical initiatives from ambiguity through to completion, ideally on a platform or infrastructure team rather than a pure product team. 
  • Experience designing and scaling distributed systems in cloud-native environments (AWS preferred; strong Azure fundamentals with genuine enthusiasm for the switch work just as well). 
  • Comfortable working with containerised services and infrastructure-as-code (Docker, Terraform; CloudFormation exposure is relevant given our current stack). 
  • Confidence writing your own unit and integration tests: we don't have a dedicated QA function. 
  • Fluent English. 

Nice to have 

  • Direct experience with C# (.NET), PostgreSQL, AWS and ECS/Kubernetes: a great fit, though not a hard requirement if your fundamentals are strong. 
  • Experience setting up infrastructure-as-code from scratch and working with it day to day, ideally with Terraform, including migrating or consolidating from other IaC approaches (like CloudFormation). 
  • Experience with Kafka or other event-driven and streaming systems (Azure Service Bus experience is a good transferable equivalent). 
  • Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, ChatGPT, Amazon CodeWhisperer) and a genuine interest in AI-driven engineering improvement. 
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, particularly for introducing new technology, like AI tooling, to other teams. 

 

What we offer 

Culture and growth 

  • A diverse and international team: work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities. 
  • Growth and development: 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and an evolving career framework. 
  • Autonomy and ownership: we empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly in an environment built on trust and transparency. 
  • Shape the future of hospitality tech: your work drives real impact from day one, at a fast-growing scale-up. 
  • Competitive and fair compensation, guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. 

 

Perks and lifestyle 

  • Flexible and remote work options: office, home or hybrid, based on what works for your role and team. 
  • A fully covered Deutschland Ticket for free public transport across Germany. 
  • Regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties and other offsite events. 
  • 30 days of paid holiday to fully disconnect, recharge and return inspired. 
  • An EGYM Wellpass membership giving access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios and wellness options. 

 

Where you'll work from 

This role is based in Munich, with hybrid working from our office there. We're also open to remote within Germany, or remote via an Employer of Record for candidates based outside in the EU/ Europe.

 

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive and welcoming workplace. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation.

Joining Apaleo means more than taking on a role. Your voice matters here, and your impact will be easy to see.

jobs.title: Content Reviewer United States - English-speaking
jobs.description:

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. We are looking for an independent, flexible, remote opportunity where you can help improve AI-powered search technology from the comfort of your home? If you're curious, internet-savvy, and enjoy evaluating online content, this freelance project could be a great fit.

 

A Day in the Life of a Content Reviewer - US

In this role, you will analyze and provide feedback on text, webpages, images, and other types of online content for leading search engines using a specialized online platform.

By reviewing and rating search results for relevance and quality, you will help improve the overall search experience for millions of users around the world, including yourself.

Join our global community and put your skills to work supporting one of the world's leading search technologies.

 

Service Rates 

The rate of pay is $0.2333 per completed task, with an estimated earning potential of $14 per hour. Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines.

Please note that only one member per household may participate in this program. If it is identified that more than one person from the same household is participating in the TELUS Digital Rating Program, all associated accounts may be removed from the program.

 

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

 

Qualification path

Qualification Process

No previous professional experience is required to apply for this opportunity. However, participation in this project requires meeting the basic requirements and successfully completing the qualification process.

 

Basic Requirements

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

• Must have resided in the United States for the past three consecutive years

• Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs in the United States

• Active use of Gmail and social media platforms

• Experience using web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of online content

• Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection

You must complete an English language assessment, pass an open book qualification exam, and complete an ID verification in order to be successful for this role. These assessments will determine your suitability for the position.

jobs.description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

 

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
  • Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
  • Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

 

The hourly earnings for this role are 18 EUR per hour, payment is based on completed tasks.

 

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands. 

Qualification path

 

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

 

Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Spanish & English.
  • Resident in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years.
  • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
  • Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.
  • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.
  • Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification
  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.

  • Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.
  • Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.

All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

jobs.title: Storyteller: Freelance B2B Interviewer and Writer
jobs.location: EMEA or APAC time zones only
jobs.description:
About the Role

Elite Editing is seeking experienced freelance journalists and content professionals to support our growing customer reference and case study programs. We call this our Storyteller role, and we are specifically looking for experienced professionals based in EMEA and APAC time zones.

Our Storytellers own the storytelling process from interview through finished draft. They lead kickoff calls with our clients and their internal stakeholders, interview their customers and subject matter experts (SMEs), identify the strongest narrative angles within the information they gather, and then write compelling case studies and customer reference stories that adhere to client-specific standards and style guides.

This is more than simply working through a list of prepared questions—or turning a transcript into copy. We need skilled storytellers who listen closely, recognize when an answer deserves further exploration, ask intelligent follow-up questions, identify the details that make a story worth telling, and then shape that material into polished, engaging content.

Our ideal freelancer has a journalism or professional interviewing background paired with extensive professional writing experience and strong editorial judgment. You should be comfortable speaking with senior business leaders, technical SMEs, and other professionals; able to quickly understand unfamiliar or complex subject matter; and skilled at transforming what you learn into a clear and compelling narrative.

What You'll Do

You will:

  • Conduct virtual kickoff calls with client stakeholders to understand the goals, context, audience, and desired direction of customer reference stories.
  • Conduct virtual interviews with our clients' customers and SMEs, often involving senior-level or highly technical professionals.
  • Review project background materials and prepare for interviews in advance.
  • Use provided interview guides as a starting point while adapting questions to the conversation.
  • Ask thoughtful, unscripted follow-up questions that uncover meaningful details, examples, outcomes, challenges, and quotable insights.
  • Identify and develop the strongest story angles from interviews, background materials, and client input.
  • Write polished B2B case studies and customer reference stories based on the information you gather, following client-specific briefs, templates, standards, and style guides.
  • Synthesize complex or technical information into accurate, accessible, and engaging narratives for the intended audience.
  • Maintain a professional, confident, and personable presence while representing Elite and our clients on calls.
  • Work collaboratively with Elite's project managers, editors, and other members of the content team throughout the development and revision process.
  • Follow client-specific processes, confidentiality requirements, and project instructions.

Job Requirements

Successful candidates must:

  • Have substantial professional writing experience, with a portfolio demonstrating the ability to develop clear, engaging, publication-ready content.
  • Have professional experience conducting interviews, preferably in journalism, B2B content, tech, publishing, corporate communications, or a related field.
  • Be located in EMEA or APAC time zones.
  • Have excellent spoken and written English and exceptional verbal communication skills.
  • Be an exceptional listener who can think on their feet and pursue useful lines of questioning in real time.
  • Be comfortable interviewing senior executives, business leaders, customers, and subject matter experts.
  • Be able to absorb unfamiliar information quickly and ask credible, informed questions about complex topics.
  • Have strong editorial judgment and be able to identify the narrative, details, and supporting evidence that will make a compelling story.
  • Be able to synthesize interviews, transcripts, background materials, and client input into a cohesive finished piece.
  • Be highly reliable, organized, responsive, and comfortable working within established processes and deadlines.
  • Have a professional remote-work setup, including reliable high-speed internet and high-quality audio/video capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

We're especially interested in candidates with one or more of the following:

  • A professional journalism background, particularly experience developing reported stories from initial research and interviews through finished copy.
  • Experience interviewing executives and subject matter experts.
  • Experience with B2B technology, enterprise technology, SaaS, cloud computing, professional services, or other complex industries.
  • Experience developing customer stories, customer reference content, case studies, thought leadership, or other long-form B2B content.
  • Experience working with or for a content, marketing, communications, or creative agency.
  • Familiarity with agency workflows in which freelancers work as part of a larger client delivery team.
  • Experience conducting interviews and developing content on behalf of major brands or enterprise organizations.
  • The ability to make interview subjects feel comfortable while keeping conversations focused and productive.

Prior agency experience is helpful but not required. We are much more interested in finding outstanding storytellers with excellent interviewing skills, writing ability, editorial judgment, curiosity, and professionalism.

Freelance Relationship

This is a freelance opportunity rather than a full-time staff position. Work will be offered based on project needs, Storyteller availability, subject-matter fit, and time zone.

Elite manages the broader client relationship, project workflow, and content production process. Freelancers work within established project parameters and compensation structures and collaborate with Elite's internal team and other content professionals to deliver the work.

Because interviews are scheduled with clients and their customers, this work requires the ability to commit to agreed-upon call times and arrive fully prepared.

About Elite Editing

Elite Editing is a woman-owned, fully remote strategic content agency based in Baltimore, Maryland. Founded in 2008, Elite began as an editing company and has grown into a full-service content partner supporting organizations with content strategy, writing, editing, marketing and sales enablement, AI implementation, and program management.

Our clients range from small businesses, publishers, agencies, universities, and thought leaders to some of the world's leading enterprise organizations. Our global network of writers, editors, interviewers, project managers, and other content professionals helps clients create high-quality content at scale.

Elite's approach is highly collaborative. We build specialized teams around our clients and integrate our processes with theirs, supporting everything from kickoff and research through SME interviewing, writing, editing, and final delivery.

We're serious about quality, but we're equally serious about being good people to work with. Our culture emphasizes trust, adaptability, collaboration, high standards, and finding a way to say "yes" to challenging work.

Who We'd Love to Hear From

You may be an especially strong fit if you've spent part of your career as a journalist and have since moved into freelance B2B, corporate, or branded content—or if you continue to work in journalism while taking on select commercial assignments.

If you know how to interview people well, recognize the story hiding within a conversation, and turn that raw material into compelling finished content, we'd like to hear from you.
